1138    def setup_optimization(
1139        self, 
1140        optimization_config_list:List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str,
1141        structure_list:List[BrachyStructure],
1142        add_hotspots_to_phantom:bool=False,
1143        one_hotspot_mask:bool=False,
1144        strict_name_match:bool = True,
1145        ):
1146        r"""
1147        ### Purpose:
1148        - Given the optimization config list either as a list or in a json file, put each
1149        optimization config inside the BrachyStructures. Also, create the hotspot estimator
1150        structure if needed.
1151
1152        ### Inputs:
1153        - self := the BrachyPlan object
1154        - optimization_config_list := a list of Optimization_Config objects or a path to a json file
1155        that contains the list of optimization config objects. Look at Optimization_Config 
1156        for more info on the fields of the optimization config object.
1157        - structure_list := a list of BrachyStructure objects that represent the structures in the plan.
1158        - add_hotspots_to_phantom := whether to add the hotspot estimator structures to the phantom.
1159        - strict_name_match := whether to match the structure names exactly or as substrings.
1160
1161        ### Outputs:
1162        - None := The structure objects in self.structure_list will be updated
1163        with the optimization config objects, and the hotspot estimator 
1164        structures will be created and added to self.structure_list if needed.
1165        """
1166        self._reset_optimization()
1167        self.optimization_config_dict = defaultdict(Optimization_Config)
1168        self.optimization_constraint_dict = defaultdict(Constraint_Config)
1169
1170        if isinstance(optimization_config_list, (Path, str)):
1171            optimization_config_list = Path(optimization_config_list).resolve()
1172            if str(optimization_config_list).endswith(".json"):
1173                with open(optimization_config_list, "r") as json_file:
1174                    optimization_config_list = json.load(json_file)
1175            else:
1176                raise ValueError("optimization_config_list can be a json file or a list of Optimization_Config objects")
1177        target_structure_names = [
1178            structure.name.lower() for structure in self.structure_list
1179            if structure.is_target
1180            ]
1181        for config in optimization_config_list:
1182            if config.penalty_weight_hotspot != 0:
1183                hotspot_structure_name = config.structure_name.lower()
1184                structure_matched = any(
1185                    hotspot_structure_name
1186                    in name.lower() for name in target_structure_names)
1187                if not structure_matched:
1188                    raise ValueError(
1189                        "penalty_weight_hotspot can only be set for PTV or CTV structures"
1190                    )
1191                self._set_hotspot_masks(
1192                    target_optim_config=config,
1193                    add_hotspots_to_phantom=add_hotspots_to_phantom,
1194                    one_hotspot_mask=one_hotspot_mask)
1195            for struc in structure_list:
1196                if strict_name_match:
1197                    structure_matched = config.structure_name.lower() == struc.name.lower()
1198                else:
1199                    structure_matched = config.structure_name.lower() in struc.name.lower()
1200                if structure_matched:
1201                    assert config.is_target == struc.is_target, f"The target structure in plan and optimization \
1202config do not match for structure {struc.name}"
1203                    struc.set_optimization_config(config)
1204                    self.optimization_config_dict[struc.name] = config
1205                    # check if the structure is a target and catheter
1206                    # recommendation is not needed
1207                    if config.is_target and not (config.catheter_recommendaion):
1208                        # set constraints on the catheters
1209                        for catheter in self.catheter_table:
1210                            self.optimization_constraint_dict[catheter.name_id] = Constraint_Config(
1211                                constraint_type="bound",
1212                                variable_type="catheter",
1213                                equal=1,
1214                                variable_name_ids=[catheter.name_id]
1215                            )
1216                    break
1217
1218    def _set_hotspot_masks(
1219        self,
1220        target_optim_config: Optimization_Config,
1221        add_hotspots_to_phantom:bool=False,
1222        one_hotspot_mask:bool=True
1223        ):
1224        r"""
1225        ### Purpose:
1226        - to create masks where hotspots are likely to occur inside the ptv or ctv.
1227        These masks are created as spheres with radius of dwell step size centered in 
1228        between two dwell positions that are within a step size distance from each other.
1229        There could be only one hotspot structure per each dwell pair.
1230        The hotspot masks are added added to the optimization config of the target structure.
1231
1232        ### Inputs:
1233        - self := the BrachyPlan object
1234        - target_optim_config := the optimization config object that contains the parameters for 
1235        the hotspot structure
1236        - add_hotspots_to_phantom := whether to add the hotspot estimator structures to the phantom.
1237        - one_hotspot_mask := whether to combine all hotspot masks into one structure or keep them
1238
1239        ### Outputs:
1240        - None := a list of hotspot masks that are added to the optimization config of
1241        the target structure.
1242        """
1243        step_size = self.catheter_table.step_size
1244        # identify unique dwell pairs that are withi n the step size distance
1245        dwell_pairs = []
1246        def distance(pos1, pos2):
1247            return np.linalg.norm(pos1 - pos2)
1248        def center(pos1, pos2):
1249            return (pos1 + pos2) / 2
1250        
1251        all_dwells:List[DwellPosition] = self.catheter_table.all_dwells
1252
1253        for i in range(len(all_dwells)):
1254            for j in range(i + 1, len(all_dwells)):
1255                current_distance = distance(
1256                    all_dwells[i].position,
1257                    all_dwells[j].position) 
1258                if current_distance <= step_size:
1259                    dwell_pairs.append(
1260                        {
1261                            "dwell_pair": (
1262                                {
1263                                    "dwell": all_dwells[i].name_id,
1264                                },
1265                                {
1266                                    "dwell": all_dwells[j].name_id,
1267                                }),
1268                            "center": center(
1269                                all_dwells[i].position,
1270                                all_dwells[j].position
1271                            ),
1272                            "radius": step_size,
1273                            "distance": current_distance,
1274                            "inter-catheter": True if (
1275                                all_dwells[i].catheter_index
1276                                != all_dwells[j].catheter_index
1277                                ) else False
1278                        }
1279                    )
1280        # create hotspot structures masks for each dwell pair
1281        hotspot_mask_list = []
1282        if all_dwells[0].dose_rate is None:
1283            reference_image = self.phantom.image_obj
1284        else:
1285            reference_image = all_dwells[0].dose_rate.dose_image
1286
1287        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
1288            futures = {
1289                executor.submit(
1290                    _gen_hotspot_mask,
1291                    dwell_pair,
1292                    reference_image.gridSize,
1293                    reference_image.origin,
1294                    reference_image.spacing,
1295                ): dwell_pair for dwell_pair in dwell_pairs
1296            }
1297            for action in tqdm(
1298                as_completed(futures),
1299                desc="Generating hotspot estimator volumes",
1300                total=len(dwell_pairs)
1301            ):
1302                try:
1303                    hotspot_mask_list.append(action.result())
1304                except:
1305                    raise ValueError("failed building hotspot volumes")
1306        if one_hotspot_mask:
1307            mask_union = np.zeros_like(
1308                hotspot_mask_list[0].imageArray, dtype=bool
1309            )
1310            for mask in hotspot_mask_list:
1311                mask_union = np.logical_or(mask_union, mask.imageArray)
1312            target_optim_config.hotspot_masks = [
1313                ROIMask(
1314                    name="hotspot_estimator_combined",
1315                    imageArray=mask_union,
1316                    origin=reference_image.origin,
1317                    spacing=reference_image.spacing
1318                )
1319            ]
1320        else:
1321            target_optim_config.hotspot_masks = hotspot_mask_list
1322
1323        if add_hotspots_to_phantom:
1324            for mask in hotspot_mask_list:
1325                self.phantom.set_structure_set(
1326                    mask_dict={mask.name: mask},
1327                    mask_colors={mask.name:[251, 159, 255]}
1328                    )
1329
1330    def _reset_optimization(self):
1331        r"""
1332        ### Purpose:
1333        - to reset the optimization configurations of all structures in the plan.
1334
1335        ### Inputs:
1336        - self := the BrachyPlan object
1337
1338        ### Outputs:
1339        - None := optimization_config attribute of all structures in the plan is set to None
1340        """
1341        for structure in self.structure_list:
1342            if structure.name.startswith("hotspot_estimator_"):
1343                self.structure_list.remove(structure)
1344                self.phantom.remove_structure(structure.name)
1345                continue
1346            structure.optimization_config = None
1347
1348    def get_dose_rate_matrices_for_catheter(
1349        self,
1350        catheter_index: int
1351    ) -> Dict[str, BrachyDose]:
1352        r"""
1353        ### Purpose:
1354        - to get the dose rate matrices for all dwell positions in a given catheter.
1355        this function assumes that dose rate dictionary matches the index+1 convension.
1356
1357        ### Inputs:
1358        - catheter_index := the index of the catheter in the catheter table
1359
1360        ### Outputs:
1361        - Dict[BrachyDose]: A dictionary containing the dose rates for the speicific catheter.
1362        the keys are in the format catheter_{index+1}_dwell_{index+1}
1363        """
1364        catheter = self.catheter_table[catheter_index]
1365        dose_rates_catheter = defaultdict(BrachyDose)
1366        for dwell in catheter.dwells:
1367            dose_rates_catheter[
1368                f"dwell_{dwell.name_id}"
1369                ] = dwell.dose_rate
1370        return dose_rates_catheter

Purpose:

  • This class holds the information regarding the brachytherapy treatment plan as well as all the functions to support the necessary plan operations.

Attributes:

Geometry and Structure Attributes:

  • phantom (BrachyPhantom): A BrachyPhantom object containing the patient geometry and structures.
  • structure_list (List[BrachyStructure]): A list of BrachyStructure objects containing the patient structures.
  • structure_dict (Dict[str, BrachyStructure]): A dictionary of the BrachyStructure objects with the phantom structure names as keys. This is automatically computed from the structure_list.
  • body_contour (ROIContour): The body contour of the patient.
  • phantom_origin (list): The origin of the phantom in the patient coordinate system.
  • organ_bounds (list): Min and max coordinates of the patient organs on each axis.

  • dvh_metric_goals (dict): Dictionary containing the DVH metric goals for the plan. The keys are the structure names from phantom. The names are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or. For example D95%(organName).

  • dvh_metrics_observed (dict): Dictionary containing the observed DVH metrics for the plan.

  • prescription_dose (float): The dose prescribed to the target volume.

Catheter and Dwell Position Attributes:

  • catheter_table (CatheterTable): A catheter table object containing the catheter information.
  • num_catheters (int): The number of catheters in the plan.

Applicator Attributes:

  • applicator_list (List[BrachyApplicator]): The list of all applicators in the plan.
  • applicator_rotation_axis (np.array): The rotation axis of applicators (default: [0, 0, 1]).
  • applicator_rotation_origin (np.array): The rotation origin of applicators (default: [0, 0, 0]).

Dose Attributes:

  • combined_dose (BrachyDose): Sum of the dose rate maps weighted by the dwell times.

Simulation and Optimization Attributes:

  • simulation_setup (BrachySimulation): A simulation setup object containing source info and simulation parameters.
  • optimization_config_dict (Dict[str, Optimization_Config]): Dictionary of optimization configurations for the plan. The keys are the structure names from phantom (usually loaded from DICOM RS). The structure name attribute could be a substring of the structure name in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".
  • optimization_constraint_dict (Dict[str, Constraint_Config]): Dictionary of optimization constraints for the plan. see Constraint_Config for more details.
BrachyPlan( phantom: Union[pathlib._local.Path, brachyutils.geometry.BrachyPhantom, dict] = None, prescription_dose: float | str | pathlib._local.Path = None, catheter_table: Union[pathlib._local.Path, brachyutils.geometry.CatheterTable, str] = None, applicator_pth_list: Union[pathlib._local.Path, str, list] = None, combined_dose: Union[pathlib._local.Path, str, brachyutils.brachy_types.BrachyDose] = None, dir_dose_rate: pathlib._local.Path = None, simulation_setup: dict | pathlib._local.Path | str = None, optimization_config_list: Union[List[Optimization_Config], pathlib._local.Path, str] = None, **kwargs) 
 84    def __init__(
 85        self,
 86        #### for geometry definition:
 87        phantom: Union[Path, BrachyPhantom, dict] = None,
 88        #### for structure creation:
 89        prescription_dose: float | str | Path = None,
 90        #### for loading catheter table and/or applicators:
 91        catheter_table: Union[Path, CatheterTable, str] = None,
 92        applicator_pth_list: Union[Path, str, list] = None,
 93        #### for loading dose or uncertainty:
 94        combined_dose: Union[Path, str, BrachyDose] = None,
 95        dir_dose_rate: Path = None,
 96        #### for simulation setup:
 97        simulation_setup: dict | Path | str = None,
 98        #### for optimization setup:
 99        optimization_config_list:  List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str = None,
100        **kwargs
101    ):
102        r"""
103        ### Purpose:
104        - To initialize the BrachyPlan object.
105
106        ### Inputs:
107        #### For geometry definition:
108        - phantom: Path|BrachyPhantom|dict := the phantom object, the path to the phantom directory,
109        or a dictionary containing the paths. A phantom object can include structures as well. See load_phantom() for more info.
110
111        #### For Structure optimization and dosimetry
112        - prescription_dose: float | str | Path = None := The dose that is prescribed to the target volume.
113        This is used to calculate the DVH metrics. It can be a float or the path to a dicom file with prescription dose.
114
115        #### For loading catheter table and applicators:
116        - catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a json file containing the information of the catheter table.
117        - applicator_pth_list := The list of applicator paths or the path to the json file containing the list. see load_applicator_list() for more info.
118
119        #### for loading dose rates or uncertainty maps per dwell position:
120        - combined_dose: Path|BrachyDose := the path to the combined dose file or a BrachyDose object.
121        - dir_dose_rate:str := path to the directory containing the dose rate files for a patient.
122
123        #### for simulation setup:
124        - simulation_setup = None := dictionary containing the simulation setup,
125        - load_uncertainty:bool := If True, the uncertainties of the dose rates are also loaded. 
126        - multi_processing:bool :=  If True, 16 threads are used to load the dose rates simulatenously.
127        - combined_dose_only:bool := If True, all the dose rates will be removed from memory after 
128        combined dose is calculated.
129        - dose_dtype:np.float32 := The floating point type to store the dose rates. 
130
131        #### for optimization setup:
132        - optimization_config_list: List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str := A list of
133        Optimization_Config objects or the path to a json file containing the list.
134
135        #### Keywords Arguments:
136        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True := if True, will only load the dwell positions that
137        had non-zero dwell times in the DICOM plan file. If False, will load all the dwell positions
138        from the digitization points.
139        - dwells_near_ptv: bool = True := if True, will remove the dwell positions that are outside PTV
140        with a margine of 10 mm.
141        - add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False := if True, will add hotspot structures to the phantom.
142        this is good for debugging, but slows down the plan creation process.
143        - one_hotspot_mask: bool: = True := if False, will create separate hotspot structures
144        - applicator_format:str = "RapidBrachy" := the format of the applicator list 
145        (default is "RapidBrachy"). See load_applicator_list() for more info. 
146        - load_uncertainty: bool := If true, it will the uncertainty of the dose rates as well.
147        - dvh_metric_goals: List[str] | Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List[str, float]] |  Path | str :=
148        A list of all DVH metric names or the dictionary containing the DVH metric names and 
149        their goals or the path to its json file. Look at set_dvh_metric_goals for guideline on the
150        names of the DVH metrics. The phantom should be loaded with structures for the Brachy
151        stuctures to be created. The names are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents 
152        the numerical threshold and "|" is or. For example D95%(organName).
153        - strict_name_match: bool = True := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric
154        as well as the structure name in the optimization config should match perfectly. Otherwise, the name 
155        of the structure in the DVH metric goals and optimization config can be a substring of the name of
156        the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".
157        - non_overlapping_structures := If true, all the structures that overlap with the target volume
158        will be carved out of it. Use it wisely my friend!
159
160        ### Outputs:
161            - None := will initialize the BrachyPlan object
162        """
163        # declare the attributes
164        # patient origin is used as a reference point for the catheter table,
165        # the dwell coordinates, image origin, egsphant, and the dose objects.
166
167        # phantom and geometry attributes
168        self.phantom: BrachyPhantom = None
169        self.dvh_metric_goals: dict = None
170        self._structure_dict: Dict[BrachyStructure] = None
171        self.structure_list: List[BrachyStructure] = []
172        self.target_structure_names:List[str] = None
173        self.body_contour: ROIContour = None
174        self.phantom_origin: list = None  # np.array([0, 0, 0])  # x,y,z
175        self.organ_bounds: list = None
176
177        # catheter table attributes
178        self.catheter_table: CatheterTable = None
179        # applicator attributes
180        self.applicator_list: List[BrachyApplicator] = []
181        self.applicator_rotation_axis: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 1])  # x,y,z
182        self.applicator_rotation_origin: float = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # x,y,z
183
184        # simulation attributes
185        self.simulation_setup: BrachySimulation = None
186
187        # optimization attributes
188        self.optimization_config_dict: Dict[str, Optimization_Config] = None
189        self.optimization_constraint_dict: Dict[str, Constraint_Config] = None
190 
191        ## fill the attributes depending on the inputs to the constructor
192        # load the prescription dose if the path is provided.
193        if prescription_dose is not None:
194            if isinstance(prescription_dose, Path) or isinstance(prescription_dose, str):
195                prescription_dose = Path(prescription_dose)
196                dicom_dose = pydicom.dcmread(prescription_dose)
197                try:
198                    prescription_dose = float(dicom_dose[0x3007, 0x1000].value)
199                except KeyError:
200                    raise KeyError(f"No prescription dose found at {prescription_dose}, please set it manually.")
201        self.prescription_dose = prescription_dose
202
203        # load the dicom plan if the path is provided
204        if phantom is not None:
205            if isinstance(phantom, BrachyPhantom):
206                self.phantom = phantom
207            elif (
208                isinstance(phantom, Path)
209                or isinstance(phantom, str)
210                or isinstance(phantom, dict)
211            ):
212                self.load_phantom(phantom)
213            else:
214                raise ValueError("phantom should be a BrachyPhantom object or a path")
215        # create structures based on the phantom structures and DVH metric goals
216        if self.phantom is not None:
217            if self.phantom.structure_set is not None:
218                self.set_brachy_structure_list(
219                    phantom=self.phantom,
220                    non_overlapping_structures=kwargs.get("non_overlapping_structures", False)
221                )
222
223        if kwargs.get("dvh_metric_goals", None) is not None:
224            dvh_metric_goals = kwargs.get("dvh_metric_goals")
225            if self.prescription_dose is None:
226                raise ValueError("prescription dose is not provided. Please provide it.")
227            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, str) or isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, Path):
228                dvh_metric_goals = Path(dvh_metric_goals)
229                with open(dvh_metric_goals, "r") as json_file:
230                    dvh_metric_goals = json.load(json_file)
231            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, list):
232                self.set_dvh_metric_goals(
233                    dvh_metric_names=dvh_metric_goals,
234                    strict_name_match=kwargs.get("strict_name_match", True))
235            elif isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, dict):
236                self.set_dvh_metric_goals(
237                    dvh_metric_goals=dvh_metric_goals,
238                    strict_name_match=kwargs.get("strict_name_match", True))
239        # load the catheter table if the path is provided
240        if catheter_table is not None:
241            self.set_catheter_table(
242                catheter_table=catheter_table,
243                from_delivered_dwellpositions=kwargs.get("from_delivered_dwellpositions", False),
244                dwells_near_ptv=kwargs.get("dwells_near_ptv", True),
245                )
246        # load the dose rate dict if the path is provided
247        if dir_dose_rate is not None and combined_dose is None:
248            self.catheter_table.load_dose_rates(
249                dir_dose_rate=dir_dose_rate,
250                load_uncertainty=kwargs.get("load_uncertainty", False),
251                multi_processing=kwargs.get("multi_processing", True),
252                combined_dose_only=kwargs.get("combined_dose_only", False),
253                dose_dtype=kwargs.get("dose_dtype", np.float32),
254                )
255        elif dir_dose_rate is None and combined_dose is not None:
256            self.catheter_table.set_combined_dose(combined_dose)
257        elif dir_dose_rate is not None and combined_dose is not None:
258            raise ValueError(
259                "invalid input. Please provide either dir_dose_rate or combined_dose but not both"
260            )
261        
262        # # load the simulation setup if the dictionary is provided
263        if simulation_setup is not None:
264            if isinstance(simulation_setup, dict):
265                self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
266                    **simulation_setup
267                )
268            elif isinstance(simulation_setup, Path) or isinstance(
269                simulation_setup, str
270            ):
271                # if json file, load the entire simulation dict from json file
272                if str(simulation_setup).endswith(".json"):
273                   self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
274                    pth_simulation_setup=simulation_setup
275                )
276                # if dicom plan file, load the source from the dicom file
277                # and assuming the catheter table is loaded from the same dicom file,
278                # provide the total time from the catheter table
279                elif str(simulation_setup).endswith(".dcm"):
280                    self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
281                        brachy_source=simulation_setup,
282                        total_time=self.catheter_table.treatment_time if self.catheter_table else 0,
283                        )
284
285        # load the applicator list if the path is provided
286        if applicator_pth_list is not None and applicator_format is not None:
287            self.load_applicator_list(
288                applicator_pth_list, kwargs.get("applicator_format", "RapidBrachy"))
289
290        # # setup optimization
291        if optimization_config_list is not None:
292            self.setup_optimization(
293                optimization_config_list,
294                self.structure_list,
295                add_hotspots_to_phantom=kwargs.get("add_hotspots_to_phantom", False),
296                one_hotspot_mask=kwargs.get("one_hotspot_mask", False),
297                strict_name_match=kwargs.get("strict_name_match", True)
298            )

Purpose:

  • To initialize the BrachyPlan object.

Inputs:

For geometry definition:

  • phantom: Path|BrachyPhantom|dict := the phantom object, the path to the phantom directory, or a dictionary containing the paths. A phantom object can include structures as well. See load_phantom() for more info.

For Structure optimization and dosimetry

  • prescription_dose: float | str | Path = None := The dose that is prescribed to the target volume. This is used to calculate the DVH metrics. It can be a float or the path to a dicom file with prescription dose.

For loading catheter table and applicators:

  • catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a json file containing the information of the catheter table.
  • applicator_pth_list := The list of applicator paths or the path to the json file containing the list. see load_applicator_list() for more info.

for loading dose rates or uncertainty maps per dwell position:

  • combined_dose: Path|BrachyDose := the path to the combined dose file or a BrachyDose object.
  • dir_dose_rate:str := path to the directory containing the dose rate files for a patient.

for simulation setup:

  • simulation_setup = None := dictionary containing the simulation setup,
  • load_uncertainty:bool := If True, the uncertainties of the dose rates are also loaded.
  • multi_processing:bool := If True, 16 threads are used to load the dose rates simulatenously.
  • combined_dose_only:bool := If True, all the dose rates will be removed from memory after combined dose is calculated.
  • dose_dtype:np.float32 := The floating point type to store the dose rates.

for optimization setup:

  • optimization_config_list: List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str := A list of Optimization_Config objects or the path to a json file containing the list.

Keywords Arguments:

  • from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True := if True, will only load the dwell positions that had non-zero dwell times in the DICOM plan file. If False, will load all the dwell positions from the digitization points.
  • dwells_near_ptv: bool = True := if True, will remove the dwell positions that are outside PTV with a margine of 10 mm.
  • add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False := if True, will add hotspot structures to the phantom. this is good for debugging, but slows down the plan creation process.
  • one_hotspot_mask: bool: = True := if False, will create separate hotspot structures
  • applicator_format:str = "RapidBrachy" := the format of the applicator list (default is "RapidBrachy"). See load_applicator_list() for more info.
  • load_uncertainty: bool := If true, it will the uncertainty of the dose rates as well.
  • dvh_metric_goals: List[str] | Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List[str, float]] | Path | str := A list of all DVH metric names or the dictionary containing the DVH metric names and their goals or the path to its json file. Look at set_dvh_metric_goals for guideline on the names of the DVH metrics. The phantom should be loaded with structures for the Brachy stuctures to be created. The names are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or. For example D95%(organName).
  • strict_name_match: bool = True := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric as well as the structure name in the optimization config should match perfectly. Otherwise, the name of the structure in the DVH metric goals and optimization config can be a substring of the name of the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".
  • non_overlapping_structures := If true, all the structures that overlap with the target volume will be carved out of it. Use it wisely my friend!

Outputs:

- None := will initialize the BrachyPlan object
phantom: brachyutils.geometry.BrachyPhantom
dvh_metric_goals: dict
structure_list: List[BrachyStructure]
target_structure_names: List[str]
body_contour: opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour
phantom_origin: list
organ_bounds: list
catheter_table: brachyutils.geometry.CatheterTable
applicator_list: List[brachyutils.geometry.BrachyApplicator]
applicator_rotation_axis: <built-in function array>
applicator_rotation_origin: float
simulation_setup: BrachySimulation
optimization_config_dict: Dict[str, Optimization_Config]
optimization_constraint_dict: Dict[str, brachyutils.planning.optimization.optim_configs.Constraint_Config]

def load_phantom(self, pth_phantom: Union[pathlib._local.Path, dict]): 
312    def load_phantom(self, pth_phantom: Union[Path, dict]):
313        r"""
314        ### Purpose:
315        - To load phantom from file path into Brachy Plan. Not that if a directory is provided,
316        it should have only one phantom file.
317
318        ### Inputs:
319        - pth_phantom:str := The phantom path could be a directory of DICOM files
320        or a directory of NRRD files. In addition, it could be the path to a json
321        file containing paths to specific phantom files. Look at the inputs of BrachPhantom
322        for more information on the expected keys of the json file.
323
324        ### Outputs:
325        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.phantom attribute
326        """
327        os.path.exists(pth_phantom), f"phantom path does not exist: {pth_phantom}"
328        # initialize the inputs to the BrachyPhantom object
329        dir_dicom = None
330        pth_phantom_file = None
331        pth_structures_file = None
332        pth_egsphant_file = None
333        # if the paths are provided as a dictionary
334        if isinstance(pth_phantom, dict):
335            phantom_config = pth_phantom
336            for key in phantom_config:
337                if key == "dir_dicom":
338                    dir_dicom = phantom_config.get(key)
339                elif key == "pth_phantom_file":
340                    pth_phantom_file = phantom_config.get(key)
341                elif key == "pth_structures_file":
342                    pth_structures_file = phantom_config.get(key)
343                elif key == "pth_egsphant_file":
344                    pth_egsphant_file = phantom_config.get(key)
345        # check if the pth_phantom is a directory or a json file
346        elif os.path.isdir(pth_phantom):
347            print("loading phantom from directory")
348            # check if the directory contains dicom files or nrrd files
349            file_list = glob(os.path.join(pth_phantom, "*.dcm"))
350            if len(file_list) > 0:
351                dir_dicom = pth_phantom
352                pth_structures_file = list(filter(lambda x: "RS" in x, file_list))[0]
353            else:
354                file_list = glob(os.path.join(pth_phantom, "*.nrrd"))
355                if len(file_list) > 0:
356                    for file_name in file_list:
357                        if file_name.endswith(".seg.nrrd"):
358                            pth_structures_file = file_name
359                        elif file_name.endswith(".egsphant.nrrd"):
360                            pth_egsphant_file = file_name
361                        elif file_name.endswith(".nrrd"):
362                            pth_phantom_file = file_name
363                    if pth_egsphant_file is None:
364                        pth_egsphant_file = glob(
365                            os.path.join(pth_phantom, "ct.egsphant.nrrd")
366                        )
367                        if len(pth_egsphant_file) == 0:
368                            pth_egsphant_file = None
369                else:
370                    raise ValueError(
371                        "invalid directory. Please provide a directory containing dicom or nrrd files"
372                    )
373        else:
374            assert (
375                os.path.splitext(pth_phantom)[1] == ".json"
376            ), "invalid file format. Please provide a json file"
377            with open(pth_phantom, "r") as json_file:
378                phantom_config = json.load(json_file)
379            for key in phantom_config:
380                if key == "dir_dicom":
381                    dir_dicom = phantom_config.get(key)
382                elif key == "pth_phantom_file":
383                    pth_phantom_file = phantom_config.get(key)
384                elif key == "pth_structures_file":
385                    pth_structures_file = phantom_config.get(key)
386                elif key == "pth_egsphant_file":
387                    pth_egsphant_file = phantom_config.get(key)
388
389        # load the phantom
390        self.phantom = BrachyPhantom(
391            dir_dicom=dir_dicom,
392            pth_phantom_file=pth_phantom_file,
393            pth_structures_file=pth_structures_file,
394            pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file,
395        )
396        self.phantom_origin = self.phantom.image_obj.origin

def set_catheter_table( self, catheter_table: Union[pathlib._local.Path, brachyutils.geometry.CatheterTable], from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True, dwells_near_ptv: bool = True): 
398    def set_catheter_table(
399        self,
400        catheter_table: Union[Path, CatheterTable],
401        from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True,
402        dwells_near_ptv: bool = True,):
403        r"""
404        ### Purpose:
405        - To set the catheter table of the plan and update the plan attributes accordingly.
406
407        ### Inputs:
408        - catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a
409        json file containing the information of the catheter table.
410        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := Whether to load only the delivered dwell positions
411        from the catheter table. Only applicable if the catheter table is loaded from a DICOM plan file. 
412        If False, all the dwell positions from the digitization points will be loaded.
413        - dwells_near_ptv: bool := Whether to remove dwells that are far from the PTV.
414
415        ### Outputs:
416        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.catheter_table attribute and all the related attributes
417        such as dwell times, coordinates, etc.
418        """
419        if isinstance(catheter_table, (str, Path)):
420            self.catheter_table = CatheterTable(
421                catheters_dict=catheter_table,
422                from_delivered_dwellpositions=from_delivered_dwellpositions,
423                )
424        elif isinstance(catheter_table, CatheterTable):
425            if self.catheter_table is None:
426                self.catheter_table = catheter_table
427            else:
428                self.catheter_table.merge(catheter_table)
429        else:
430            raise ValueError(
431                "catheter_table should be a path or a CatheterTable object"
432            )
433        if dwells_near_ptv:
434            for structure in self.structure_list:
435                if structure.is_target:
436                    if isinstance(structure.mask, ROIContour):
437                        mask = structure.mask.getBinaryMask(
438                            origin=self.phantom.image_obj.origin,
439                            gridSize=self.phantom.image_obj.gridSize,
440                            spacing=self.phantom.image_obj.spacing,
441                        )
442                    else:
443                        mask = structure.mask
444                    self.catheter_table.remove_outside_mask(
445                        mask=mask,
446                        margin_mm=5.0,
447                    )

  • dwells_near_ptv: bool := Whether to remove dwells that are far from the PTV.

def set_dvh_metric_goals( self, dvh_metric_names: Union[List[str], pathlib._local.Path] = None, dvh_metric_goals: Union[Dict[str, float], Dict[str, List], pathlib._local.Path] = None, strict_name_match: bool = True) -> None: 
449    def set_dvh_metric_goals(
450        self,
451        dvh_metric_names: List[str] | Path = None,
452        dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List] | Path = None,
453        strict_name_match: bool = True
454        ) -> None:
455        r"""
456        ### Purpose:
457        - To set the dvh metric list of the BrachyPlan object and each of the BrachyStructures.
458        You can provide either the dvh_metric_names or the dvh_metric_goals.
459
460        ### Inputs:
461        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
462        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
463        For example D95%(organName).
464        - dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List[str, float]] := The dictionary mapping the
465        DVH metric names to their corresponding goal value. see self.set_dvh_metric_names() for 
466        the naming convention of the keys.
467        If the value is a list, the first element is the operation for that metric. The operations 
468        could are "<=", ">=", and "==". The second element is the goal value. For example:
469            {
470                "D95%(CTV)": [">=", 95],
471                "V100%(CTV)": [">=", 90],
472                "D2cc(Bladder)": ["<=", 75],
473            }
474        - strict_name_match: bool := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric
475        goals should mask perfectly. Otherwise, the name of the structure in the DVH metric goals can be
476        a substring of the name of the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".
477
478        ### Outputs:
479        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals attribute as well as 
480        BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_names and BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_goals.
481        The keys of the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals are:
482        {
483            BrachyStructure.name: {
484                "dvh_metric_names: [list of the names for that structure],
485                "dvh_metric_goals: {if applicable}
486            }    
487        }
488        """
489        if dvh_metric_names is not None and dvh_metric_goals is not None:
490            raise ValueError("Please provide either dvh_metric_names or dvh_metric_goals, not both") 
491
492        if len(self.structure_list) == 0:
493            raise ValueError("The plan structure set is empty, please run set_brachy_structure_list")
494
495        if isinstance(dvh_metric_names, Path):
496            with open(dvh_metric_names, "r") as json_file:
497                dvh_metric_names = json.load(json_file)
498
499        if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
500            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, Path):
501                with open(dvh_metric_goals, "r") as json_file:
502                    dvh_metric_goals = json.load(json_file)
503            dvh_metric_names = list(dvh_metric_goals.keys())
504
505        self.dvh_metric_goals = {}
506        # let's match the structure names in the DVH with the structure names
507        # in the BrachyPlan.
508        for brachy_structure in self.structure_list:
509            # get all the dvh metrics for this structure
510            structure_dvh_metrics_names = []
511            for dvh_name in dvh_metric_names:
512                structure_name_in_dvh = dvh_name.split("(")[-1].split(")")[0]
513                if strict_name_match:
514                    if brachy_structure.name == structure_name_in_dvh:
515                        structure_dvh_metrics_names.append(dvh_name)
516                    else:
517                        continue
518                else:
519                    if structure_name_in_dvh in brachy_structure.name:
520                        structure_dvh_metrics_names.append(dvh_name)
521                    else:
522                        continue
523            if len(structure_dvh_metrics_names) == 0:
524                continue
525            self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
526                "dvh_metric_names": structure_dvh_metrics_names}
527            brachy_structure.set_dvh_metric_names(
528                self.dvh_metric_goals.get(
529                    brachy_structure.name).get(
530                        "dvh_metric_names")
531            )
532            if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
533                structure_dvh_metric_goals = {}
534                for dvh_name in structure_dvh_metrics_names:
535                    structure_dvh_metric_goals[
536                        dvh_name] = dvh_metric_goals[dvh_name]
537                self.dvh_metric_goals[
538                    brachy_structure.name][
539                        "dvh_metric_goals"] = structure_dvh_metric_goals 
540                brachy_structure.set_dvh_metric_goals(
541                    self.dvh_metric_goals.get(brachy_structure.name).get("dvh_metric_goals")
542                )

Purpose:

  • To set the dvh metric list of the BrachyPlan object and each of the BrachyStructures. You can provide either the dvh_metric_names or the dvh_metric_goals.

Inputs:

  • dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or. For example D95%(organName).
  • dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List[str, float]] := The dictionary mapping the DVH metric names to their corresponding goal value. see self.set_dvh_metric_names() for the naming convention of the keys. If the value is a list, the first element is the operation for that metric. The operations could are "<=", ">=", and "==". The second element is the goal value. For example: { "D95%(CTV)": [">=", 95], "V100%(CTV)": [">=", 90], "D2cc(Bladder)": ["<=", 75], }
  • strict_name_match: bool := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric goals should mask perfectly. Otherwise, the name of the structure in the DVH metric goals can be a substring of the name of the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".

Outputs:

  • None := will update the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals attribute as well as BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_names and BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_goals. The keys of the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals are: { BrachyStructure.name: { "dvh_metric_names: [list of the names for that structure], "dvh_metric_goals: {if applicable} }
    }
def set_brachy_structure_list( self, phantom: brachyutils.geometry.BrachyPhantom, mask_type: Union[opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour, opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask] = <class 'opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask'>, non_overlapping_structures: bool = False) -> None: 
544    def set_brachy_structure_list(
545        self,
546        phantom: BrachyPhantom,
547        mask_type: Union[ROIContour, ROIMask] = ROIMask,
548        non_overlapping_structures:bool = False
549        )->None:
550        r"""
551        ### Purpose:
552        - To create a list of BrachyStructure objects from the structures in the phantom.
553        Each BrachyStructure object will have attributes for the structure
554        contour, the DVH and uncertainty volume histograms, optimization attributes,
555        and simulation attributes. Here, we only set the mask. We also ensure that there is
556        no overlap between the mask of the target structure and the OARs, priority is given
557        to OAR.
558
559        ### Inputes:
560        - phantom := the phantom with its structures fully loaded.
561        - dvh_metric_goals := the dvh metric goals dictionary
562        - mask_type: ROIContour | ROIMask := Phantom masks will be converted to this type when being
563        stored in BrachySturucture.
564        - non_overlapping_structures := If true, all the structures that overlap with the target volume
565        will be carved out of it. Use it wisely my friend!
566        ### Outputs:
567        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.structure_list attribute
568        """
569        self.structure_list = []
570        if phantom.cached_structure_masks is not None:
571            structure_masks = deepcopy(phantom.cached_structure_masks)
572        else:
573            structure_masks: dict = phantom.get_structure_mask(
574                phantom.structure_names, mask_type,
575            )
576
577        for structure_name in structure_masks.keys():
578            structure_obj = BrachyStructure(
579                name=structure_name,
580                mask=structure_masks[structure_name],
581                is_target=True if (
582                    "ctv" in structure_name.lower()
583                    or "ptv" in structure_name.lower())  else False,
584            )
585            self.structure_list.append(structure_obj)
586        self.body_contour = phantom.get_structure_mask(
587            ["body"],
588            mask_type=ROIContour,
589            strict_name_match=False,).get("body", None)
590
591        self.target_structure_names = [
592            structure.name for structure 
593            in self.structure_list if structure.is_target]
594
595        if non_overlapping_structures:
596            # If there is an OAR that goes through the PTV, cut it out of PTV.
597            # this is because each voxel can have planning role only.
598            # in prostate, the urethra goes through the PTV.
599            for target_structure in self.target_structure_names:
600                for structure in self.structure_list:
601                    if structure.is_target:
602                        continue
603                    if "body" in structure.name.lower():
604                        continue 
605                    # find intersection between this structure and target_structure
606                    overlap = (
607                        self.structure_dict.get(target_structure).mask.imageArray 
608                        &  structure.mask.imageArray)
609                    if np.any(overlap):
610                        self.structure_dict.get(target_structure).mask.imageArray = (
611                            self.structure_dict.get(target_structure).mask.imageArray 
612                            & (np.ma.ones_like(overlap)^overlap))

Each BrachyStructure object will have attributes for the structure contour, the DVH and uncertainty volume histograms, optimization attributes, and simulation attributes. Here, we only set the mask. def get_dvh_metrics( self, prescription_dose: float = None, return_percentage: bool = True) -> dict: 
614    def get_dvh_metrics(
615        self,
616        prescription_dose: float = None,
617        return_percentage: bool = True,
618        ) -> dict:
619        r"""
620        ### Purpose:
621        - To get the observed value of the dvh metric for each structure in the BrachyPlan.
622        the observed value is calculated from the combined dose map.
623
624        ### Inputs:
625        - self := the BrachyPlan object
626
627        ### Outputs:
628        - dvh_metrics_observed: a dictionary mapping every DVH metric to its observed value.
629        """
630        assert self.structure_list is not None, "structure list is not created yet"
631        assert self.prescription_dose is not None, "prescription dose is not set"
632        assert self.dvh_metric_goals is not None, "DVH metrics are not set, please run set_dvh_metric_goals()"
633
634        combined_dose = self.combined_dose
635        if prescription_dose is None:
636            prescription_dose = self.prescription_dose
637        dvh_metrics_observed = {}
638        for structure_obj in self.structure_list:
639            if "hotspot_estimator" in structure_obj.name.lower():
640                continue
641            if (structure_obj.dvh_metric_names is None
642                or (not any(structure_obj.dvh_metric_names))):
643                continue
644            observed_metrics = structure_obj.get_dvh_metric(
645                combined_dose,
646                prescription_dose,
647                return_percentage,
648                self.body_contour,
649                )
650            dvh_metrics_observed.update(observed_metrics)
651        return dvh_metrics_observed

Purpose:

  • To get the observed value of the dvh metric for each structure in the BrachyPlan. the observed value is calculated from the combined dose map.

Inputs:

  • self := the BrachyPlan object

Outputs:

  • dvh_metrics_observed: a dictionary mapping every DVH metric to its observed value.

def calculate_uncertainty_per_structure(self): 
685    def calculate_uncertainty_per_structure(self):
686        r"""
687        ### Purpose:
688        - To calculate the uncertainty of each structure in the BrachyPlan.
689
690        ### Inputs:
691        - self := the BrachyPlan object
692
693        ### Outputs:
694        - None := will update the BrachyStructure.uncertainty attribute
695        """
696        assert (
697            self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image is not None
698        ), "combined uncertainty is not calculated yet"
699        assert self.structure_list is not None, "structure list is not created yet"
700        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
701            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
702        )
703
704        for structure_obj in self.structure_list:
705            # resample the uncertainty image on the structure
706            structure_mask = structure_obj.mask.getBinaryMask(
707                origin=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.origin,
708                spacing=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.spacing,
709                gridSize=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.gridSize
710            )
711            masked_uncertainty = self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray * structure_mask.imageArray
712
713            # isolate the uncertainty values that are in the mask
714            flattened_uncertainty = masked_uncertainty.flatten()
715            # generate a histogram from the masked uncertainty
716            histogram, bins_edges = np.histogram(
717                flattened_uncertainty,
718                bins=100,
719                range=(0, flattened_uncertainty.max() + 0.1),
720            )
721            structure_obj.uvh = histogram * np.prod(self.combined_dose.dose_image.spacing)
722            structure_obj.uncertainty_mean = np.mean(flattened_uncertainty)
723            structure_obj.uncertainty_std = np.std(flattened_uncertainty)
724            structure_obj.uncertainty_max = np.max(flattened_uncertainty)
725            structure_obj.uncertainty_min = np.min(flattened_uncertainty)

  • self := the BrachyPlan object

Outputs:

  • None := will update the BrachyStructure.uncertainty attribute
def export_brachy_plan( self, content_to_export: ExportConfig_BrachyPlan | dict): 
727    def export_brachy_plan(
728        self,
729        content_to_export: ExportConfig_BrachyPlan | dict,
730        ):
731        r"""
732        ### Purpose:
733        - To export the brachytherapy treatment plan and its components to files based on the
734        provided export configuration. Supports exporting dose, catheter tables, plan files,
735        simulation macros, egsphant files, applicator geometries, and structure sets.
736
737        ### Inputs:
738        - content_to_export := ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object or dictionary containing export
739        configuration. If a dictionary is provided, it will be converted to an ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object.
740        
741        The configuration object/dictionary should contain:
742            - dir_export (Path): Directory where exported files will be written.
743            - export_config_dose (ExportConfig_Dose|None): Dose export configuration.
744            - export_config_cathetertable (ExportConfig_CatheterTable|None): Catheter table export configuration.
745            - export_config_plan_and_mac (ExportConfig_PlanAndMac|None): Plan and Mac file export configuration.
746            - export_config_egsphant (ExportConfig_Egsphant|None): Egsphant file export configuration.
747            - applicator_geometry (bool): Whether to export applicator geometry.
748            - structure_set (bool): Whether to export structure set.
749
750        ### Outputs:
751        - None := Exported files are written to the directory specified in content_to_export.dir_export.
752        The function conditionally exports the following file types based on configuration:
753            - Dose files (combined dose and optionally dose rate maps)
754            - Catheter table (.json or .mrk.json)
755            - Plan files (.plan files for each dwell position)
756            - Macro files (.mac simulation files)
757            - Egsphant phantom file (ct.egsphant)
758            - Applicator stl files
759            - Structure set file (structure_set.json)
760
761        ### Dependencies:
762        - ExportConfig_BrachyPlan
763        - export_dose()
764        - export_catheter_table()
765        - export_plan_files()
766        - export_mac_files()
767        - _export_egsphant()
768        - _export_structure_set()
769
770        ### Example of content_to_export dict:
771        ```python
772        EXPORT_CONFIG = {
773            "dir_export": "/path/to/export/directory",
774            "export_config_dose": {
775                "name_combined": "combined",
776                "write_dose_rate_maps": False,
777                "multi_processing": True
778            },
779            "export_config_cathetertable": {
780                "name": "catheter_table",
781                "remove_text": True,
782                "one_markup_per_catheter": False
783            },
784            "export_config_egsphant": {
785                "name": "egsphant",
786                "assign_material_from_ct": False,
787                "strict_name_match": False
788            },
789            "export_config_plan_and_mac": {
790                "combined_only": True,
791                "name_combined": "combined",
792                "body_mesh_name": "BODY"
793            },
794            "applicator_geometry": False,
795            "structure_set": False
796        }
797        ```
798        """
799        if isinstance(content_to_export, dict):
800            content_to_export = ExportConfig_BrachyPlan(**content_to_export)
801        dir_export = content_to_export.dir_export
802        dir_export.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
803
804        if content_to_export.export_config_dose:
805            self.catheter_table.export_dose(content_to_export.export_config_dose)
806
807        if content_to_export.export_config_cathetertable:
808            self.export_catheter_table(
809                export_config_cathetertable=content_to_export.export_config_cathetertable,
810                catheter_table=self.catheter_table,
811            )
812
813        if content_to_export.export_config_egsphant:
814            self._export_egsphant(
815                export_config_egsphant=content_to_export.export_config_egsphant
816            )
817
818        if content_to_export.export_config_plan_and_mac:
819            self.export_plan_files(
820                export_config_plan_and_mac=content_to_export.export_config_plan_and_mac,
821                catheter_table=self.catheter_table,
822                )
823            self.export_mac_files(
824                export_config_plan_and_mac=content_to_export.export_config_plan_and_mac,
825                catheter_table=self.catheter_table
826                )
827
828
829        if content_to_export.applicator_geometry:
830            for applicator in self.applicator_list:
831                applicator.to_stl(dir_export / f"{applicator.name}.stl")
832
833        if content_to_export.structure_set:
834            self._export_structure_set(
835                str(dir_export), content_to_export.get("materials_table", None)
836            )

def export_plan_files( self, export_config_plan_and_mac: ExportConfig_PlanAndMac, catheter_table: brachyutils.geometry.CatheterTable): 
865    def export_plan_files(
866        self,
867        export_config_plan_and_mac:ExportConfig_PlanAndMac,
868        catheter_table:CatheterTable,
869        ):
870        r"""
871        ### Purpose:
872        - To export dwell positions and their normalized times into ".plan" text files in the
873        format required by RapidBrachy.
874
875        ### Inputs:
876        - export_config_plan_and_mac = The export configuration for the plan files. see ExportConfig_PlanAndMac
877        - catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.
878
879        ### Outputs:
880        - None := Two types of .plan files are written, one named combined.plan and the other
881        named run_{dwellNumber}.plan. combined.plan contains info of all dwell positions and
882        their normalized dwell time, and the run_{dwellNumber}.plan contains info of a single
883        dwell position. The format of each .plan file is given in this example:
884            "Treatment Plan
885            56 Control Points
886            Control Point
887            weight = 0.00327228
888            1 Dwell Position
889            -10.2819,82.598,-1224.98,-0.0291444,-0.017922,0.999415,0,0,0,1,0,0,0
890            Control Point ..."
891
892        ### Dependencies:
893            - None
894        """
895        total_dwell_time = catheter_table.treatment_time
896        num_dwells = catheter_table.num_dwell_positions
897        combined_plan = "Treatment Plan\n"
898        combined_plan += f"{num_dwells} Control Points\n"
899
900        for cat in catheter_table:
901            for dwell in cat.dwells:
902                if not dwell.gen_dose_rate:
903                    continue
904                dwell_coordinates_str = np.array(
905                    list(dwell.position)
906                    + list(dwell.rotation)
907                    + [dwell.angle]
908                    + list(self.applicator_rotation_axis)
909                    + list(self.applicator_rotation_origin),
910                    dtype=np.float32,
911                )
912                dwell_coordinates_str = (
913                    ",".join(
914                        [
915                            str(int(coord)) if coord == int(coord) else format(coord, ".6f")
916                            for coord in dwell_coordinates_str
917                        ]
918                    )
919                    + "\n"
920                )
921
922                catheter_idx = cat.index
923                dwell_idx = dwell.index
924                combined_plan += "Control Point\n"
925                combined_plan += f"weight = {dwell.time/total_dwell_time}\n"
926                combined_plan += f"1 Dwell Position - Catheter {catheter_idx + 1}\n"
927                combined_plan += dwell_coordinates_str
928
929                run_i_plan = "Treatment Plan\n"
930                run_i_plan += "1 Control Points\n"
931                run_i_plan += "Control Point\nweight = 1.0\n"
932                run_i_plan += "1 Dwell Position\n"
933                run_i_plan += dwell_coordinates_str
934                # Not dealing with shield angle for now but the new convention for filename is
935                # xxx_catheter#_dwell#_shieldangle.plan
936                shield_angle = dwell.angle
937                if not export_config_plan_and_mac.combined_only:
938                    order = f"{catheter_idx + 1}_{dwell_idx + 1}_{shield_angle}"
939                    with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.dir_export / f"dwell_{order}.plan", "w") as file:
940                        file.write(run_i_plan)
941    
942        if export_config_plan_and_mac.combined_only:
943            with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_plan_combined, "w") as file:
944                file.write(combined_plan)

Purpose:

  • To export dwell positions and their normalized times into ".plan" text files in the format required by RapidBrachy.

Inputs:

  • export_config_plan_and_mac = The export configuration for the plan files. see ExportConfig_PlanAndMac
  • catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.

Outputs:

  • None := Two types of .plan files are written, one named combined.plan and the other named run_{dwellNumber}.plan. combined.plan contains info of all dwell positions and their normalized dwell time, and the run_{dwellNumber}.plan contains info of a single dwell position. The format of each .plan file is given in this example: "Treatment Plan 56 Control Points Control Point weight = 0.00327228 1 Dwell Position -10.2819,82.598,-1224.98,-0.0291444,-0.017922,0.999415,0,0,0,1,0,0,0 Control Point ..."

- None
def export_mac_files( self, export_config_plan_and_mac: ExportConfig_PlanAndMac, catheter_table: brachyutils.geometry.CatheterTable): 
 946    def export_mac_files(
 947        self,
 948        export_config_plan_and_mac: ExportConfig_PlanAndMac,
 949        catheter_table:CatheterTable,
 950        ):
 951        r"""
 952        ### Purpose:
 953        - To export the simulation parameters of the plan into a macro files
 954        and run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac
 955
 956        ### Inputs:
 957        - export_config_plan_and_mac:= The export configuration for macro files.
 958        - catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.
 959
 960        ### Outputs:
 961        - None := Two types of .mac files are written, one named combined.mac and the other
 962        named run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac. combined.plan contains
 963
 964        plan contains info of a single dwell position.
 965
 966        The format of each .mac file is given in this example:
 967            /source_world/treatmentType HDR
 968            /source_world/switch MicroSelectronV2
 969            /source_world/coreMaterial G4_Ir
 970            /source_world/core/A 192
 971            /source_world/core/Z 77
 972            /sim/plan combined.plan
 973            /world/phantom ct.egsphant
 974            /parallel_world/ak_per_history 1.149000e-11
 975            /parallel_world/ref_ak 4.278729e+04
 976            /parallel_world/H 2.500000e+00
 977            /parallel_world/total_time 4.531841e+02
 978            /dose/format 3ddose
 979            /run/numberOfThreads 40
 980            /run/initialize
 981            /control/verbose 0
 982            /run/verbose 0
 983            /tracking/verbose 0
 984            /run/printProgress 1000000
 985            /sim/beamOn 10000000
 986        ### Dependencies:
 987        - simulation_utils
 988        """
 989        sim_obj = deepcopy(self.simulation_setup)
 990        sim_obj.total_time = catheter_table.treatment_time
 991        sim_obj.pth_plan = export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_plan_combined.name
 992        sim_obj.pth_phantom = export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_phantom
 993        sim_obj.applicator_list = self.applicator_list
 994
 995        if export_config_plan_and_mac.auto_mvm:
 996            #check if we need it - if the dimensions of the image are sufficiently small
 997            if any(self.phantom.egsphant_obj.material_image.gridSizeInWorldUnit < 400): #if our phantom is smaller than 40 cm in any direction
 998                for structure in self.phantom.structure_names:
 999                    if structure.lower() == "body" or structure.lower() == "external":
1000                        export_config_plan_and_mac.body_mesh_name = structure
1001                    #material already defaults to soft tissue
1002
1003        if export_config_plan_and_mac.body_mesh_name is not None:
1004            sim_obj.pth_body_stl = export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_body_stl.name
1005            sim_obj.body_material = export_config_plan_and_mac.body_mesh_material
1006            body_mask = self.phantom.get_structure_mask([export_config_plan_and_mac.body_mesh_name], mask_type = ROIMask, strict_name_match=False)[export_config_plan_and_mac.body_mesh_name]
1007
1008            from brachyutils.geometry.phantom_utils import mask_to_stl
1009
1010            mask_to_stl(
1011                roi_mask=body_mask,
1012                pth_output=export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_body_stl
1013            )
1014
1015
1016        if export_config_plan_and_mac.combined_only:
1017            with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_mac_combined, "w") as file:
1018                file.write(sim_obj.to_string())
1019
1020        else:
1021            for cat in catheter_table:
1022                for dwell in cat.dwells:
1023                    catheter_idx = cat.index
1024                    dwell_idx = dwell.index
1025                    # Not dealing with shield angle for now but the new convention for filename is
1026                    # xxx_catheter#_dwell#_shieldangle.plan
1027                    shield_angle = dwell.angle
1028                    order = f"{catheter_idx + 1}_{dwell_idx + 1}_{shield_angle}"
1029                    sim_obj.pth_plan = f"dwell_{order}.plan"
1030                    sim_obj.total_time = 1
1031
1032                    with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.dir_export / f"run_{order}.mac", "w") as file:
1033                        file.write(sim_obj.to_string())
1034        print(".mac files were exported successfully")

Purpose:

  • To export the simulation parameters of the plan into a macro files and run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac

Inputs:

  • export_config_plan_and_mac:= The export configuration for macro files.
  • catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.

Outputs:

  • None := Two types of .mac files are written, one named combined.mac and the other named run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac. combined.plan contains

plan contains info of a single dwell position.

The format of each .mac file is given in this example: /source_world/treatmentType HDR /source_world/switch MicroSelectronV2 /source_world/coreMaterial G4_Ir /source_world/core/A 192 /source_world/core/Z 77 /sim/plan combined.plan /world/phantom ct.egsphant /parallel_world/ak_per_history 1.149000e-11 /parallel_world/ref_ak 4.278729e+04 /parallel_world/H 2.500000e+00 /parallel_world/total_time 4.531841e+02 /dose/format 3ddose /run/numberOfThreads 40 /run/initialize /control/verbose 0 /run/verbose 0 /tracking/verbose 0 /run/printProgress 1000000 /sim/beamOn 10000000

def setup_optimization( self, optimization_config_list: Union[List[Optimization_Config], pathlib._local.Path, str], structure_list: List[BrachyStructure], add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False, one_hotspot_mask: bool = False, strict_name_match: bool = True): 
1138    def setup_optimization(
1139        self, 
1140        optimization_config_list:List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str,
1141        structure_list:List[BrachyStructure],
1142        add_hotspots_to_phantom:bool=False,
1143        one_hotspot_mask:bool=False,
1144        strict_name_match:bool = True,
1145        ):
1146        r"""
1147        ### Purpose:
1148        - Given the optimization config list either as a list or in a json file, put each
1149        optimization config inside the BrachyStructures. Also, create the hotspot estimator
1150        structure if needed.
1151
1152        ### Inputs:
1153        - self := the BrachyPlan object
1154        - optimization_config_list := a list of Optimization_Config objects or a path to a json file
1155        that contains the list of optimization config objects. Look at Optimization_Config 
1156        for more info on the fields of the optimization config object.
1157        - structure_list := a list of BrachyStructure objects that represent the structures in the plan.
1158        - add_hotspots_to_phantom := whether to add the hotspot estimator structures to the phantom.
1159        - strict_name_match := whether to match the structure names exactly or as substrings.
1160
1161        ### Outputs:
1162        - None := The structure objects in self.structure_list will be updated
1163        with the optimization config objects, and the hotspot estimator 
1164        structures will be created and added to self.structure_list if needed.
1165        """
1166        self._reset_optimization()
1167        self.optimization_config_dict = defaultdict(Optimization_Config)
1168        self.optimization_constraint_dict = defaultdict(Constraint_Config)
1169
1170        if isinstance(optimization_config_list, (Path, str)):
1171            optimization_config_list = Path(optimization_config_list).resolve()
1172            if str(optimization_config_list).endswith(".json"):
1173                with open(optimization_config_list, "r") as json_file:
1174                    optimization_config_list = json.load(json_file)
1175            else:
1176                raise ValueError("optimization_config_list can be a json file or a list of Optimization_Config objects")
1177        target_structure_names = [
1178            structure.name.lower() for structure in self.structure_list
1179            if structure.is_target
1180            ]
1181        for config in optimization_config_list:
1182            if config.penalty_weight_hotspot != 0:
1183                hotspot_structure_name = config.structure_name.lower()
1184                structure_matched = any(
1185                    hotspot_structure_name
1186                    in name.lower() for name in target_structure_names)
1187                if not structure_matched:
1188                    raise ValueError(
1189                        "penalty_weight_hotspot can only be set for PTV or CTV structures"
1190                    )
1191                self._set_hotspot_masks(
1192                    target_optim_config=config,
1193                    add_hotspots_to_phantom=add_hotspots_to_phantom,
1194                    one_hotspot_mask=one_hotspot_mask)
1195            for struc in structure_list:
1196                if strict_name_match:
1197                    structure_matched = config.structure_name.lower() == struc.name.lower()
1198                else:
1199                    structure_matched = config.structure_name.lower() in struc.name.lower()
1200                if structure_matched:
1201                    assert config.is_target == struc.is_target, f"The target structure in plan and optimization \
1202config do not match for structure {struc.name}"
1203                    struc.set_optimization_config(config)
1204                    self.optimization_config_dict[struc.name] = config
1205                    # check if the structure is a target and catheter
1206                    # recommendation is not needed
1207                    if config.is_target and not (config.catheter_recommendaion):
1208                        # set constraints on the catheters
1209                        for catheter in self.catheter_table:
1210                            self.optimization_constraint_dict[catheter.name_id] = Constraint_Config(
1211                                constraint_type="bound",
1212                                variable_type="catheter",
1213                                equal=1,
1214                                variable_name_ids=[catheter.name_id]
1215                            )
1216                    break

def get_dose_rate_matrices_for_catheter( self, catheter_index: int) -> Dict[str, brachyutils.brachy_types.BrachyDose]: 
1348    def get_dose_rate_matrices_for_catheter(
1349        self,
1350        catheter_index: int
1351    ) -> Dict[str, BrachyDose]:
1352        r"""
1353        ### Purpose:
1354        - to get the dose rate matrices for all dwell positions in a given catheter.
1355        this function assumes that dose rate dictionary matches the index+1 convension.
1356
1357        ### Inputs:
1358        - catheter_index := the index of the catheter in the catheter table
1359
1360        ### Outputs:
1361        - Dict[BrachyDose]: A dictionary containing the dose rates for the speicific catheter.
1362        the keys are in the format catheter_{index+1}_dwell_{index+1}
1363        """
1364        catheter = self.catheter_table[catheter_index]
1365        dose_rates_catheter = defaultdict(BrachyDose)
1366        for dwell in catheter.dwells:
1367            dose_rates_catheter[
1368                f"dwell_{dwell.name_id}"
1369                ] = dwell.dose_rate
1370        return dose_rates_catheter
