class BrachyStructure: 
 11class BrachyStructure:
 12    r"""
 13    ### Purpose:
 14    - this class holds the information regarding a structure inside a brachytherapy
 15    treatment plan.
 16    ### Attributes:
 17    #### Basic Attributes
 18    - name:str
 19    - mask: ROIMask
 20    - is_target: bool
 21    #### DVH Attributes:
 22    - dvh_metric_names
 23    - in_dvh: bool
 24    - dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float]
 25    - dvh_metrics_observed: Dict[str, float]
 26    - dvh_obj: opentps.core.data.DVH
 27    #### Uncertainty Attributes:
 28    - uvh
 29    - uncertainty_mean
 30    - uncertainty_std
 31    - uncertainty_max
 32    - uncertainty_min
 33    #### Optimization Attributes:
 34    - optimization_config:Optimization_Config := the optimization config object for the structure. see optim_utils.py  
 35    ### Functions:
 36        - get_dvh_metric(combined_dose:BrachyDose)
 37        - to_dict()
 38    """
 39
 40    def __init__(
 41        self,
 42        name: str,
 43        mask: ROIMask | ROIContour,
 44        dvh_metric_names: List[str] = None,
 45        dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] = None,
 46        is_target: bool = False,
 47        in_dvh: bool = True,
 48        optimization_config: Optimization_Config = None,
 49        ) -> None:
 50        r"""
 51        ### Purpose:
 52        - To initialize the BrachyStructure object.
 53        ### Inputs:
 54        - name:str := the name of the structure.
 55        - mask:ROIMask | ROIContour := the mask or contour of the structure.
 56        - is_target:bool := flag to indicate whether the structure is a target volume or not.
 57        - in_dvh:bool := flag to indicate whether the structure is included in the dose volume histogram.
 58        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
 59        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
 60        For example D95%(organName).
 61        - dvh_metric_goals:Dict[str, float] := a dictionary of DVH metrics and their clinical goals.
 62        - optimization_config:Optimization_Config := the optimization config object for the structure. see optim_utils.py 
 63        ### Outputs:
 64        - None := will initialize the BrachyStructure object
 65        ### Dependencies:
 66        - opentps.core.data.ROIMask
 67        - opentps.core.data.DVH
 68        """
 69        self.name = name
 70        self.mask = mask
 71        self.is_target = is_target
 72
 73        # dose volume histogram
 74        self.in_dvh:bool = in_dvh
 75        self.dvh_metric_names: List[str] = None
 76        self.dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] = None
 77        self.dvh_metrics_observed: Dict[str, float] = None
 78        self.dvh_obj: DVH = None
 79
 80        # uncertainty volume histogram
 81        self.uvh: np.array = None
 82        self.uncertainty_mean: float = None
 83        self.uncertainty_std: float = None
 84        self.uncertainty_max: float = None
 85        self.uncertainty_min: float = None
 86
 87        # optimization attributes
 88        self.optimization_config: Optimization_Config = None
 89        # self.optimization_mask: ROIMask = None
 90        if dvh_metric_names is not None:
 91            self.set_dvh_metric_names(dvh_metric_names)
 92
 93        if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
 94            self.dvh_metric_goals(dvh_metric_goals)
 95
 96        if optimization_config is not None:
 97            self.set_optimization_config(optimization_config)
 98
 99    def set_dvh_metric_names(self, dvh_metric_names: List[str]):
100        r"""
101        ### Purpose:
102        - To set the DVH metric names for this structure.
103        ### Inputs:
104        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
105        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
106        For example D95%(organName).
107        ### Outputs:
108        - None:= will update self.dvh_metric_names
109        """
110        # assert np.all( let's let go of this sanity check qnd favor chaotic progress over 
111        # orderly stagnation!
112        #     [self.name.lower() in dvh_metric_name.lower()
113        #     for dvh_metric_name in dvh_metric_names]),\
114        #     "name should be in dvh metric name enclosed by paranthesis"
115        self.dvh_metric_names = dvh_metric_names
116
117    def set_dvh_metric_goals(
118        self,
119        dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List]):
120        r"""
121        ### Purpose:
122        - To set the DVH metrics or their goals for this structure.
123        The keys should ideally match the self.dvh_metric_names.
124        if self.dvh_metric_names is None, this function sets the names based on the keys.
125        ### Inputs:
126        - dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List[str, float]] := The dictionary mapping the
127        DVH metric names to their corresponding goal value. see self.set_dvh_metric_names() for 
128        the naming convention of the keys.
129        If the value is a list, the first element is the operation for that metric. The operations 
130        could are "<=", ">=", and "==". The second element is the goal value. For example:
131            {
132                "D95%(CTV)": [">=", 95],
133                "V100%(CTV)": [">=", 90],
134                "D2cc(Bladder)": ["<=", 75],
135            }
136        """
137        if self.dvh_metric_names is None:
138            self.set_dvh_metric_names(list(dvh_metric_goals.keys()))
139
140        self.dvh_metric_goals = defaultdict(float)
141        for dvh_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
142            self.dvh_metric_goals[dvh_name] = dvh_metric_goals.get(dvh_name, None)
143
144    def get_dvh_metric(
145        self,
146        combined_dose: BrachyDose,
147        prescription_dose: float = None,
148        return_percentage: bool = False,
149        body_contour: ROIContour = None,
150        ) -> Dict[str, float]:
151        r"""
152        ### Purpose:
153        - To calculate the DVH metric for the structure given the combined dose.
154        The mask contour and DVH metrics should be set before calling this function.
155        We expect the the dvh metric name to be in the format of "D#cc(organName)",
156        "D#%(organName)", "V#Gy(organName)" or "V#%(organName)", HI(organName) or CI(organName),
157        where # is the threshold value, for example "D95%(organName)". HI is for homogeniety index
158        and CI is for conformity index implemented by OpenTPS.
159        ### Inputs:
160        - combined_dose := the combined dose object for the patient.
161        - prescription_dose := the prescribed dose to the target volume (PTV or CTV).
162        - return_percentage := if true, the value of the dvh metric is normalized to
163        the prescription dose for Dcc or D% and to the volume of the organName for VGy or V%.
164        - body_contour := the body contour is needed for conformity index calculation.
165        If the body contour is not provided, the conformity index will not be calculated.
166        ### Outputs:
167        - None := will update the BrachyStructure.dvh_metrics_observed dictionary and
168        BrachyStructure.dvh_obj attributes. Will also update the last calculated value
169        to BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_observed for backward compatibility (deprecated).
170        """
171        assert self.mask is not None, "mask is not loaded"
172        assert any(self.dvh_metric_names), "dvh metric goals are not set"
173        #assert (
174        #    self.dvh_metric_clinical_goal is not None
175        #), "dvh metric clinical goal is not set"
176        assert isinstance(
177            combined_dose, BrachyDose
178        ), "combined dose is not a BrachyDose object"
179        self.dvh_obj = DVH(
180            self.mask,
181            combined_dose.dose_image,
182            prescription=prescription_dose,
183            # maxDVH=combined_dose.dose_image.imageArray.max(), XXX if the max dose is veyr large, it'll break the histogram
184            )
185        self.dvh_metrics_observed = {}
186
187        for dvh_metric_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
188            metric_string = dvh_metric_name.split("(")[0]
189
190            if metric_string.startswith("D"):
191                if "%" in metric_string:
192                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("D")[-1])
193                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDx(threshold, return_percentage)
194                elif "cc" in metric_string:
195                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("cc")[0].split("D")[-1])
196                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDcc(threshold, return_percentage)
197                else:
198                    raise ValueError(
199                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
200                        The metrics starting with 'D' should have percent sign (%) or cc.\
201                        for example 'D95%(organ name)' or 'D2cc(organ name)'"
202                    )
203
204            elif metric_string.startswith("V"):
205                if "%" in metric_string:
206                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("V")[-1])
207                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVx(threshold, return_percentage)
208                elif "Gy" in metric_string:
209                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("Gy")[0].split("V")[-1])
210                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVg(threshold, return_percentage)
211                else:
212                    raise ValueError(
213                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
214                        The metrics starting with 'V' should have percent sign (%) or Gy.\
215                        for example 'V95%(organ name)' or 'V2Gy(organ name)'"
216                    )
217            elif metric_string.startswith("HI"):
218                if return_percentage:
219                    hi = self.dvh_obj.homogeneityIndex()*100
220                else:
221                    hi = self.dvh_obj.homogeneityIndex()                    
222                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = hi
223            elif metric_string.startswith("CI"):
224                if body_contour is None:
225                    raise ValueError("body_contour should be defined to compute the conformity index")
226                elif isinstance(body_contour, ROIMask):
227                    assert np.allclose(body_contour.gridSize, combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize), \
228                    f"body contour grid size does not match dose grid size, {body_contour.gridSize} vs {combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize}"
229                else:
230                    # body contour is ROIContour, it's good to go
231                    pass
232                if return_percentage:
233                    ci = self.dvh_obj.conformityIndex(body_contour)*100
234                else:
235                    ci = self.dvh_obj.conformityIndex(body_contour)
236                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = ci
237            else:
238                raise ValueError(
239                    "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
240                    The metric should should start with D followed by cc or %, or V followed by Gy or %.\
241                    or HI for homogeniety index or CI for conformityIndex"
242                )
243            warnings.warn("""BrachyStructure attribute dvh_metric_observed is deprecated.
244                            Please use dvh_metrics_observed dictionary instead.""", DeprecationWarning)
245            self.dvh_metric_observed = list(self.dvh_metrics_observed.values())[0]
246
247        return self.dvh_metrics_observed
248
249    def to_dict(self):
250        r"""
251        ### Purpose:
252        - To export the BrachyStructure object into a dictionary of a certain format.
253        ### Outputs:
254        - {
255            "density": 0,
256            "density_mode": "",
257            "dose_voxel_goal": 0,
258            "dvhConstraints": "",
259            "in_dvh": true,
260            "linear_weight": 1,
261            "material": "CT Material",
262            "max_dose": 500,
263            "min_dose": 0,
264            "name": "BODY",
265            "quadratic_weight": 1,
266            "type": "" or "Target volume" or "Organ at risk",
267            "uniformity_weight": 1}
268
269        """
270        return {
271            "density": self.density,
272            "density_mode": self.density_mode,
273            "dose_voxel_goal": self.dose_voxel_goal,
274            "dvhConstraints": "",
275            "in_dvh": self.in_dvh,
276            "linear_weight": self.penalty_weight_linear,
277            "material": self.material,
278            "max_dose": self.max_dose,
279            "min_dose": self.min_dose,
280            "name": self.name,
281            "quadratic_weight": self.penalty_weight_quadratic,
282            "type": "Target volume" if self.is_target else "Organ at risk",
283            "uniformity_weight": self.penalty_weight_uniformity,
284        }
285
286    def info(self):
287        print(self.to_dict())
288
289    def set_optimization_config(
290        self,
291        optimzation_config: Optimization_Config=None,
292        **kwargs
293        ) -> None:
294        r"""
295        ### Purpose:
296        - To prepare the BrachyStructure object for optimization.
297        ### Inputs:
298
299        - None := will update the BrachyStructure object with the optimization id and
300        will set the penalty weights to 1.0.
301        """
302        from brachyutils.planning.optimization.optim_configs import Optimization_Config
303        if optimzation_config is not None:
304            self.optimization_config = optimzation_config
305        else:
306            if kwargs is None:
307                raise ValueError("Please provide optimization config")
308            self.optimization_config = Optimization_Config(kwargs)
309        self.optimization_config.dwell_coef_dict = defaultdict()

def set_dvh_metric_goals(self, dvh_metric_goals: Union[Dict[str, float], Dict[str, List]]): 
117    def set_dvh_metric_goals(
118        self,
119        dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List]):
120        r"""
121        ### Purpose:
122        - To set the DVH metrics or their goals for this structure.
123        The keys should ideally match the self.dvh_metric_names.
124        if self.dvh_metric_names is None, this function sets the names based on the keys.
125        ### Inputs:
126        - dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] | Dict[str, List[str, float]] := The dictionary mapping the
127        DVH metric names to their corresponding goal value. see self.set_dvh_metric_names() for 
128        the naming convention of the keys.
129        If the value is a list, the first element is the operation for that metric. The operations 
130        could are "<=", ">=", and "==". The second element is the goal value. For example:
131            {
132                "D95%(CTV)": [">=", 95],
133                "V100%(CTV)": [">=", 90],
134                "D2cc(Bladder)": ["<=", 75],
135            }
136        """
137        if self.dvh_metric_names is None:
138            self.set_dvh_metric_names(list(dvh_metric_goals.keys()))
139
140        self.dvh_metric_goals = defaultdict(float)
141        for dvh_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
142            self.dvh_metric_goals[dvh_name] = dvh_metric_goals.get(dvh_name, None)

def get_dvh_metric( self, combined_dose: brachyutils.dose.BrachyDose, prescription_dose: float = None, return_percentage: bool = False, body_contour: opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour = None) -> Dict[str, float]: 
144    def get_dvh_metric(
145        self,
146        combined_dose: BrachyDose,
147        prescription_dose: float = None,
148        return_percentage: bool = False,
149        body_contour: ROIContour = None,
150        ) -> Dict[str, float]:
151        r"""
152        ### Purpose:
153        - To calculate the DVH metric for the structure given the combined dose.
154        The mask contour and DVH metrics should be set before calling this function.
155        We expect the the dvh metric name to be in the format of "D#cc(organName)",
156        "D#%(organName)", "V#Gy(organName)" or "V#%(organName)", HI(organName) or CI(organName),
157        where # is the threshold value, for example "D95%(organName)". HI is for homogeniety index
158        and CI is for conformity index implemented by OpenTPS.
159        ### Inputs:
160        - combined_dose := the combined dose object for the patient.
161        - prescription_dose := the prescribed dose to the target volume (PTV or CTV).
162        - return_percentage := if true, the value of the dvh metric is normalized to
163        the prescription dose for Dcc or D% and to the volume of the organName for VGy or V%.
164        - body_contour := the body contour is needed for conformity index calculation.
165        If the body contour is not provided, the conformity index will not be calculated.
166        ### Outputs:
167        - None := will update the BrachyStructure.dvh_metrics_observed dictionary and
168        BrachyStructure.dvh_obj attributes. Will also update the last calculated value
169        to BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_observed for backward compatibility (deprecated).
170        """
171        assert self.mask is not None, "mask is not loaded"
172        assert any(self.dvh_metric_names), "dvh metric goals are not set"
173        #assert (
174        #    self.dvh_metric_clinical_goal is not None
175        #), "dvh metric clinical goal is not set"
176        assert isinstance(
177            combined_dose, BrachyDose
178        ), "combined dose is not a BrachyDose object"
179        self.dvh_obj = DVH(
180            self.mask,
181            combined_dose.dose_image,
182            prescription=prescription_dose,
183            # maxDVH=combined_dose.dose_image.imageArray.max(), XXX if the max dose is veyr large, it'll break the histogram
184            )
185        self.dvh_metrics_observed = {}
186
187        for dvh_metric_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
188            metric_string = dvh_metric_name.split("(")[0]
189
190            if metric_string.startswith("D"):
191                if "%" in metric_string:
192                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("D")[-1])
193                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDx(threshold, return_percentage)
194                elif "cc" in metric_string:
195                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("cc")[0].split("D")[-1])
196                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDcc(threshold, return_percentage)
197                else:
198                    raise ValueError(
199                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
200                        The metrics starting with 'D' should have percent sign (%) or cc.\
201                        for example 'D95%(organ name)' or 'D2cc(organ name)'"
202                    )
203
204            elif metric_string.startswith("V"):
205                if "%" in metric_string:
206                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("V")[-1])
207                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVx(threshold, return_percentage)
208                elif "Gy" in metric_string:
209                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("Gy")[0].split("V")[-1])
210                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVg(threshold, return_percentage)
211                else:
212                    raise ValueError(
213                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
214                        The metrics starting with 'V' should have percent sign (%) or Gy.\
215                        for example 'V95%(organ name)' or 'V2Gy(organ name)'"
216                    )
217            elif metric_string.startswith("HI"):
218                if return_percentage:
219                    hi = self.dvh_obj.homogeneityIndex()*100
220                else:
221                    hi = self.dvh_obj.homogeneityIndex()                    
222                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = hi
223            elif metric_string.startswith("CI"):
224                if body_contour is None:
225                    raise ValueError("body_contour should be defined to compute the conformity index")
226                elif isinstance(body_contour, ROIMask):
227                    assert np.allclose(body_contour.gridSize, combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize), \
228                    f"body contour grid size does not match dose grid size, {body_contour.gridSize} vs {combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize}"
229                else:
230                    # body contour is ROIContour, it's good to go
231                    pass
232                if return_percentage:
233                    ci = self.dvh_obj.conformityIndex(body_contour)*100
234                else:
235                    ci = self.dvh_obj.conformityIndex(body_contour)
236                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = ci
237            else:
238                raise ValueError(
239                    "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
240                    The metric should should start with D followed by cc or %, or V followed by Gy or %.\
241                    or HI for homogeniety index or CI for conformityIndex"
242                )
243            warnings.warn("""BrachyStructure attribute dvh_metric_observed is deprecated.
244                            Please use dvh_metrics_observed dictionary instead.""", DeprecationWarning)
245            self.dvh_metric_observed = list(self.dvh_metrics_observed.values())[0]
246
247        return self.dvh_metrics_observed

Purpose:

  • To calculate the DVH metric for the structure given the combined dose. The mask contour and DVH metrics should be set before calling this function. We expect the the dvh metric name to be in the format of "D#cc(organName)", "D#%(organName)", "V#Gy(organName)" or "V#%(organName)", HI(organName) or CI(organName), where # is the threshold value, for example "D95%(organName)". HI is for homogeniety index and CI is for conformity index implemented by OpenTPS.

    Inputs:

  • combined_dose := the combined dose object for the patient.

  • prescription_dose := the prescribed dose to the target volume (PTV or CTV).
  • return_percentage := if true, the value of the dvh metric is normalized to the prescription dose for Dcc or D% and to the volume of the organName for VGy or V%.

  • body_contour := the body contour is needed for conformity index calculation. If the body contour is not provided, the conformity index will not be calculated.

    Outputs:

  • None := will update the BrachyStructure.dvh_metrics_observed dictionary and BrachyStructure.dvh_obj attributes. Will also update the last calculated value to BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_observed for backward compatibility (deprecated).

class BrachySimulation(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
161class BrachySimulation(BaseModel):
162    r"""
163    ### Purpose:
164    - A class to hold the information of a brachytherapy simulation. The
165    simulations are done using the RapidBrachyMC software.
166    ### Attributes:
167    - brachy_source: BrachySource
168    - world_material: str
169    - number_histories: int
170    - total_time: float
171    - dose_format: str
172    - number_of_threads: int
173    - control_verbose: int
174    - run_verbose: int
175    - tracking_verbose: int
176    - print_progress: int
177    - pth_plan: str
178    - pth_phantom: str
179    ### Functions:
180    - validate(): checks if the fields are valid for export.
181    - to_string(): converts the object to a string.
182    """
183    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)
184
185    brachy_source: BrachySource | Path | str = BrachySource()
186    world_material: str = "Air"
187    number_histories: int = int(1e7)
188    total_time: float = None
189    dose_format: str = "nrrd"
190    number_of_threads: int = 8
191    control_verbose: int = 0
192    run_verbose: int = 0
193    tracking_verbose: int = 0
194    print_progress: int = int(1e5)
195    pth_plan: str = "combined.plan"
196    pth_phantom: str = "phantom.seq.nrrd"
197    pth_body_stl: str = None
198    body_material: str = "Water"
199    applicator_list : List[BrachyApplicator] = []
200
201    # Exclude from dumps, default to None
202    pth_simulation_setup: Path | str | None = Field(default=None, exclude=True)
203
204    @model_validator(mode="after")
205    def process_setup_and_source(self) -> "BrachySimulation":
206        # 1. Load data from JSON if the path is provided
207        if self.pth_simulation_setup is not None:
208            pth = Path(self.pth_simulation_setup)
209            if not pth.exists():
210                raise ValueError(f"Path {pth} does not exist.")
211            
212            if pth.suffix == ".json":
213                with open(pth, "r") as f:
214                    data = json.load(f)
215                
216                # Dynamically set attributes from the JSON
217                for key, value in data.items():
218                    if hasattr(self, key):
219                        setattr(self, key, value)
220            else:
221                raise ValueError(f"File {pth} is not a json file.")
222
223        # 2. Coerce brachy_source into a BrachySource object
224        if isinstance(self.brachy_source, (Path, str)):
225            # Uses the pth_source field from our refactored BrachySource class
226            self.brachy_source = BrachySource(pth_source=self.brachy_source)
227        elif isinstance(self.brachy_source, dict):
228            self.brachy_source = BrachySource(**self.brachy_source)
229        elif not isinstance(self.brachy_source, BrachySource):
230            raise ValueError(
231                f"brachy_source should be a dictionary, a path, or a BrachySource object. Got {type(self.brachy_source)}"
232            )
233
234        return self
235
236    def to_string(self):
237        r"""
238        Purpose:
239            - to convert the object to a string.
240        Input:
241            - self: BrachySimulation
242        Output:
243            - a string containing the information of the simulation.
244        Dependencies:
245            - None
246        """
247        # self.validate()
248        outstring = (
249            f"/source/treatmentType {self.brachy_source.treatment_type}\n"
250            + f"/source/switch {self.brachy_source.source_geometry}\n"
251            + f"/source/core/material {self.brachy_source.core_material}\n"
252            + f"/source/core/A {self.brachy_source.mass_number}\n"
253            + f"/source/core/Z {self.brachy_source.atomic_number}\n"
254            + f"/sim/plan {self.pth_plan}\n"
255            + f"/world/phantom {self.pth_phantom}\n"
256        )
257        if self.pth_body_stl is not None:
258            outstring = (
259                outstring
260                + f"/world/body_mask {self.pth_body_stl}\n"
261                + f"/world/body_mask_material {self.body_material}\n"
262            )
263
264        if self.applicator_list:
265            for applicator in self.applicator_list:
266                outstring = (
267                    outstring
268                    + f"/applicator/path {applicator.name}.stl\n"
269                    + f"/applicator/material {applicator.material}\n"
270                    + f"/applicator/density {applicator.density}\n"
271                    + f"/applicator/done\n"
272                )
273        outstring = (
274            outstring
275            + f"/parallel_world/ak_per_history {self.brachy_source.air_kerma_per_history}\n"
276            + f"/parallel_world/AKS {self.brachy_source.reference_air_kerma_rate}\n"
277            + f"/parallel_world/total_time {self.total_time}\n"
278            + f"/dose/format {self.dose_format}\n"
279            + f"/run/numberOfThreads {self.number_of_threads}\n"
280            + "/run/initialize\n"
281            + f"/control/verbose {self.control_verbose}\n"
282            + f"/run/verbose {self.run_verbose}\n"
283            + f"/tracking/verbose {self.tracking_verbose}\n"
284            + f"/run/printProgress {int(self.print_progress)}\n"
285            + f"/sim/beamOn {int(self.number_histories)}"
286        )
287        
288        return outstring
289
290    def to_dict(self):
291        r"""
292        Purpose:
293            - to convert the object to a dictionary.
294        Input:
295            - self: BrachySimulation
296        Output:
297            - a dictionary containing the information of the simulation.
298        Dependencies:
299            - None
300        """
301        return (self.model_dump())
302
303    def to_json(self, output_path: Union[str, Path]):
304        r"""
305        Purpose:
306            - to convert the object to a json string.
307        Input:
308            - self: BrachySimulation
309            - output_path: Union[str, Path]
310        Output:
311            - a json string containing the information of the simulation.
312        Dependencies:
313            - json
314        """
315        with open(output_path, "w") as f:
316            json.dump(self.to_dict(), f)

204    @model_validator(mode="after")
205    def process_setup_and_source(self) -> "BrachySimulation":
206        # 1. Load data from JSON if the path is provided
207        if self.pth_simulation_setup is not None:
208            pth = Path(self.pth_simulation_setup)
209            if not pth.exists():
210                raise ValueError(f"Path {pth} does not exist.")
211            
212            if pth.suffix == ".json":
213                with open(pth, "r") as f:
214                    data = json.load(f)
215                
216                # Dynamically set attributes from the JSON
217                for key, value in data.items():
218                    if hasattr(self, key):
219                        setattr(self, key, value)
220            else:
221                raise ValueError(f"File {pth} is not a json file.")
222
223        # 2. Coerce brachy_source into a BrachySource object
224        if isinstance(self.brachy_source, (Path, str)):
225            # Uses the pth_source field from our refactored BrachySource class
226            self.brachy_source = BrachySource(pth_source=self.brachy_source)
227        elif isinstance(self.brachy_source, dict):
228            self.brachy_source = BrachySource(**self.brachy_source)
229        elif not isinstance(self.brachy_source, BrachySource):
230            raise ValueError(
231                f"brachy_source should be a dictionary, a path, or a BrachySource object. Got {type(self.brachy_source)}"
232            )
233
234        return self

  9class BrachySource(BaseModel):
 10    r"""
 11    ### Purpose:
 12    - A class to hold the information of a brachytherapy source.

 23    ### Functions:
 24    - validate(): checks if the fields are valid for export.
 25    - to_dict(): converts the object to a dictionary.
 26    """
 27
 28    treatment_type: Literal["HDR", "PLDR", "TLDR"] = "HDR"
 29    source_geometry: str = "GenericHDR"

 31    mass_number: int = 192
 32    atomic_number: int = 77

 35    activity: float = 10.0
 36    # source_dict: Union[dict, Path, str] = None
 37
 38# Exclude ensures this field doesn't show up when you export the model to a dict/json
 39    pth_source: Path | str | None = Field(default=None, exclude=True)
 40
 41    @model_validator(mode="after")

 43        if self.pth_source is not None:
 44            pth = Path(self.pth_source)
 45            
 46            if not pth.exists():
 47                raise ValueError(f"Path {pth} does not exist.")
 48            
 49            if pth.suffix == ".json":
 50                with open(pth, "r") as f:
 51                    data = json.load(f)
 52            elif pth.suffix == ".dcm":
 53                data = self.load_from_dicom(pth_dicom=pth)
 54            else:
 55                raise ValueError(f"File {pth} is not a json nor a dicom file.")
 56            
 57            # Dynamically update the instance attributes
 58            for key, value in data.items():
 59                if hasattr(self, key):
 60                    setattr(self, key, value)
 61

 64    def to_dict(self):

 81            "air_kerma_per_history": self.air_kerma_per_history,
 82            "reference_air_kerma_rate": self.reference_air_kerma_rate,
 83        }
 84
 85    def to_string(self):
 86        r"""
 87        Purpose:

 91        Output:

 93        Dependencies:

101            + f"/source/core/Z {self.atomic_number}\n"

121    @classmethod
122    def load_from_dicom(cls, pth_dicom: Union[str, Path]) -> dict:
123        r"""
124        Purpose:
125            - to load the simulation object from a dicom directory.
126        Input:
127            - self: BrachySource
128            - pth_dicom: Union[str, Path]
129        Output:
130            - None
131        Dependencies:
132            - None
133        """
134        # Ensure path exists and is directory
135        pth_dicom = Path(pth_dicom)
136        if not pth_dicom.exists():
137            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path {pth_dicom} does not exist.")
138        # Find and load the plan file
139        plan_dcm = pydicom.dcmread(str(pth_dicom))
140        # FIXME make a constant dictonary of the sources that RapidBrachy works with and 
141        # pick that source depending on the source geometry. 
142        # Fill in reference air kerma from dicom though.
143        source_dict = defaultdict(str)
144        source_dict["treatment_type"] = plan_dcm.get("BrachyTreatmentType", "HDR")
145        source_dict["source_geometry"] = plan_dcm.TreatmentMachineSequence[0].ManufacturerModelName
146        if "microselectron-hdr v2" in source_dict["source_geometry"].lower():
147            source_dict["source_geometry"] = "MicroSelectronV2"
148        elif "microselectron v3" in source_dict["source_geometry"].lower():
149            source_dict["source_geometry"] = "MicroSelectronV3"
150        elif "flexitron hdr 192-ir" in source_dict["source_geometry"].lower():
151            source_dict["source_geometry"] = "FlexiSource"
152        # source_dict["source_geometry"] = plan_dcm.get("SourceModelName", "MicroSelectronV2")
153        source_dict["core_material"] = plan_dcm.SourceSequence[0].SourceIsotopeName
154        if source_dict["core_material"] == "Ir-192":
155            source_dict["core_material"] = "G4_Ir"
156            source_dict["mass_number"] = 192
157            source_dict["atomic_number"] = 77
158            source_dict["air_kerma_per_history"] = 1.149000e-11
159        source_dict["reference_air_kerma_rate"] = plan_dcm.SourceSequence[0].ReferenceAirKermaRate
160        return source_dict

def load_dicom_to_plan( dir_dicom: pathlib._local.Path | str, load_dicom_dose: bool = False, load_dicom_source: bool = True, load_dicom_catheter_table: bool = True, load_dicom_prescription_dose: bool = True, **kwargs) -> BrachyPlan: 
1427def load_dicom_to_plan(
1428    dir_dicom: Path | str,
1429    load_dicom_dose: bool = False,
1430    load_dicom_source: bool = True,
1431    load_dicom_catheter_table: bool = True,
1432    load_dicom_prescription_dose: bool = True,
1433    **kwargs) -> BrachyPlan:
1434    r"""
1435    ### Purpose:
1436    - To load all the contents of a dicom directory into a BrachyPlan object.
1437
1438    ### Inputs:
1439    - dir_dicom := the path to the dicom directory.
1440    - load_dicom_dose := if True, the dose dicom file will be loaded.
1441    - load_dicom_source := if True, the source dicom file will be loaded.
1442    - load_dicom_catheter_table := if True, the catheter table dicom file will be loaded.
1443    - load_dicom_prescription_dose := if True, the prescription dose will be loaded from the dicom file.
1444    If False, the prescription dose will be set to None.
1445    - **kwargs := additional arguments to be passed to the BrachyPlan constructor
1446
1447    ### Outputs:
1448    - BrachyPlan := the BrachyPlan object with all the contents of the dicom directory
1449    """
1450    dir_dicom = Path(dir_dicom)
1451    dose_dcm = list(dir_dicom.glob("[Rr][Dd]*.dcm"))
1452    plan_dcm = list(chain(
1453        dir_dicom.glob("[Rr][Pp]*.dcm"),
1454        dir_dicom.glob("[Pp][Ll]*.dcm"),
1455        ))
1456
1457    if load_dicom_dose:
1458        if len(dose_dcm) != 1:
1459            raise FileNotFoundError("There should be exactly one dose dicom file that starts with RD or rd in the directory")
1460        combined_dose = kwargs.get("combined_dose", dose_dcm[0])
1461    else:
1462        combined_dose = None
1463
1464    if load_dicom_source:
1465        if len(plan_dcm) != 1:
1466            raise FileNotFoundError("There should be exactly one source dicom file that starts with RP or PL in the directory")
1467        brachy_source = plan_dcm[0]
1468    else:
1469        brachy_source = None
1470
1471    if load_dicom_catheter_table:
1472        if len(plan_dcm) != 1:
1473            raise FileNotFoundError("There should be exactly one catheter table dicom file that starts with RP or PL in the directory")
1474        catheter_table = kwargs.get("catheter_table", plan_dcm[0])
1475    else:
1476        catheter_table = None
1477
1478    if load_dicom_prescription_dose:
1479        if len(plan_dcm) != 1:
1480            raise FileNotFoundError("There should be exactly one prescription dose dicom file that starts with RP or PL in the directory")
1481        prescription_dose = plan_dcm[0]
1482    else:
1483        prescription_dose = kwargs.pop("prescription_dose", None)
1484
1485    simulation_setup = kwargs.pop("simulation_setup", None)
1486    new_sim_setup = deepcopy(simulation_setup) # this is to avoid memory reference issues during forloops
1487    if new_sim_setup is None:
1488        new_sim_setup = plan_dcm[0]
1489    if isinstance(new_sim_setup, dict):
1490        if new_sim_setup.get("brachy_source") is None:
1491            new_sim_setup["brachy_source"] = brachy_source
1492
1493    return BrachyPlan(
1494        phantom=dir_dicom,
1495        catheter_table=catheter_table,
1496        combined_dose=combined_dose,
1497        simulation_setup=new_sim_setup,
1498        prescription_dose=prescription_dose,
1499        **kwargs
1500        )

Purpose:

  • To load all the contents of a dicom directory into a BrachyPlan object.

Inputs:

  • dir_dicom := the path to the dicom directory.
  • load_dicom_dose := if True, the dose dicom file will be loaded.
  • load_dicom_source := if True, the source dicom file will be loaded.
  • load_dicom_catheter_table := if True, the catheter table dicom file will be loaded.
  • load_dicom_prescription_dose := if True, the prescription dose will be loaded from the dicom file. If False, the prescription dose will be set to None.
  • **kwargs := additional arguments to be passed to the BrachyPlan constructor

Outputs:

  • BrachyPlan := the BrachyPlan object with all the contents of the dicom directory

147class ExportConfig_BrachyPlan(BaseModel):
148    r"""
149    ### Purpose:
150    - Configuration for exporting various components of a brachytherapy treatment plan.
151    The components are catheter table, dose, egsphant, plan file, and mac file.
152
153    ### Attributes:
154    - dir_export: **[required]** Base directory where all plan components are exported.
155    - export_config_dose: Configuration for exporting dose data.
156    - export_config_cathetertable: Configuration for exporting catheter table.
157    - export_config_egsphant: Configuration for exporting egsphant file.
158    - export_config_plan_and_mac: Configuration for exporting plan and mac file.
159    - applicator_geometry: Whether to export applicator geometry into an STL file.
160    - structure_set: Whether to export structure set info into a JSON file.
161    """
162    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)
163    dir_export:str | Path = Field(..., description="Base directory where all plan components are exported.")
164    export_config_dose: ExportConfig_Dose | bool = Field(False, description="Configuration for exporting dose data.")
165    export_config_cathetertable: ExportConfig_CatheterTable | bool = Field(False, description="Configuration for exporting catheter table.")
166    export_config_egsphant: ExportConfig_Egsphant | bool = Field(False, description="Configuration for exporting egsphant file.")
167    export_config_plan_and_mac: ExportConfig_PlanAndMac | bool = Field(False, description="Configuration for exporting .plan and .mac files.")
168    # TODO: in future, add these export configs if neeeded
169
170    # export_config_applicator: ExportConfig_Applicator = None
171    # export_config_phantom: ExportConfig_BrachyStructure = None
172
173    applicator_geometry: bool = Field(False, description="Whether to export applicator geometry into a stl file.")
174    structure_set: bool = Field(False, description="Whether to export structure set info into a json file.")
175
176    @model_validator(mode="before")
177    def validate_inputs(data):
178        for k, v in data.items():
179            if k.startswith("export_config_") and isinstance(v, bool):
180                data[k] = {} if v else False
181            if k=="dir_export":
182                data[k] = Path(v)
183        return data
184
185    @model_validator(mode="after")
186    def validate_config(self):
187        # make sure that the paths of dir exports are 
188        # set correctly for all the inner attributes
189        for _, value in self:                
190            if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
191                if value.dir_export is None:
192                    value.dir_export = self.dir_export
193        return self

class Optimization_Config(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
182class Optimization_Config(BaseModel):
183    """
184    ### Purpose:
185    - This class holds the information regarding the optimization configuration per each structure.
186    When loading the BrachyPlan the optimization config is created for each structure in the plan.structure_list.
187    Some attributes are unique to target structures (CTV/PTV) and some are common to all structures.
188    target attributes: 
189        - penalty_weight_hotspot
190        - hotspot_threshold
191        - catheter_recommendaion
192        - penalty_weight_variance_time
193        - penalty_weight_uniformity
194
195    ### Attributes:
196    - structure_name: str := The name of the structure to which this optimization config applies.
197    - is_target: bool := If true, we're looking at a target structure.
198    - spacing_mm: List[float] | float := The spacing of the optimization grid in mm. 
199    - dose_voxel_goal: float := The dose goal for every voxel in the structure in Gy.
200    - penalty_weight_linear: float := Weight for linear penalty term in objective function. Linear 
201    penalty means for each voxel we get the difference between the target dose for that voxel and
202    the value that is already being delivered ($x$). Default 1.
203    - penalty_weight_quadratic: float := Weight for quadratic penalty term. This is obtained by squaring
204    the linear penalty per voxel ($x^2$). Default 1.
205    - penalty_weight_hotspot: float := Weight for hotspot penalty term. Default 0.
206    - hotspot_threshold: float := If the average dose to the hot spot estimator volume (defined as a sphere centered around
207    two dwell positions with radius of 5 mm) goes above (target_dose * hotspot_threshold), penalty 
208    will be calculated for that hot spot estimator volume. Default 0.
209    - penalty_weight_uniformity: float := weight for the quadratic dose uniformity penalty ($x^2$).
210    Uniformity penalty here focuses on sharpenning the fall of PTV's DVH curve. Default 1.
211    - penalty_weight_variance_time: float := linear weight to reduce the variance of the dwell times.
212    - mask_margin_mm: List[float] | float := Margin around structure for optimization in mm. Default 0.
213    - min_dose: float := Minimum allowed dose in Gy. Default 0.
214    - max_dose: float := Maximum allowed dose in Gy. Default 500.
215    minimum, maximum and the exact number of catheters desired in the plan.
216    - catheter_recommendaion: bool := If True, catheter positions will be optimized as well, otherwise
217    all the catheter variables will be constraint to one.
218    - dwell_coef_dict: Dict[str, np.array] := A dictionary mapping the name of the dwell position to the cropped, masked
219    and flattend dose rate map corresponding to that dwell positition.
220    """
221    model_config = ConfigDict(
222        arbitrary_types_allowed=True,
223        validate_assignment=True,
224        )
225
226    structure_name:str = None
227    is_target:bool = False
228    spacing_mm:float | List[float]= None
229    dose_voxel_goal:float = None
230    penalty_weight_linear:float = 0
231    penalty_weight_quadratic:float = 0
232    penalty_weight_hotspot:float = 0
233    hotspot_threshold:float = 0
234    penalty_weight_uniformity:float = 0
235    penalty_weight_variance_time:float = 0
236    mask_margin_mm:float | List[float]= 0
237    min_dose:float = 0
238    max_dose:float = 500
239    catheter_recommendaion: bool = False
240    dwell_coef_dict:Dict[str, np.ndarray] = None
241    mask:ROIMask = None
242    hotspot_masks: List[ROIMask] = None
243    num_dose_points: int = None
244    hotspot_num_dose_points: List[int] = None
245
246    @model_validator(mode="after")
247    def validate_target_only_fields(self):
248        if not self.is_target:
249            assert self.penalty_weight_hotspot == 0, "only target structure can have penalty_weight_hotspot"
250            assert self.hotspot_threshold == 0, "only target structure can have hotspot_threshold"
251            assert self.catheter_recommendaion == False, "only target structure can have catheter_recommendaion"
252            assert self.penalty_weight_variance_time == 0, "only target structure can have penalty_weight_variance_time"
253            assert self.penalty_weight_uniformity == 0, "only target structure can have penalty_weight_uniformity"
254            assert self.hotspot_masks == None, "only target structure can have hotspot_masks"
255        return self
256
257    def to_dict(self)->dict:
258        return {
259            "structure_name": self.structure_name,
260            "is_target": self.is_target,
261            "spacing_mm": self.spacing_mm,
262            "dose_voxel_goal": self.dose_voxel_goal,
263            "penalty_weight_linear": self.penalty_weight_linear,
264            "penalty_weight_quadratic": self.penalty_weight_quadratic,
265            "penalty_weight_hotspot": self.penalty_weight_hotspot,
266            "hotspot_threshold": self.hotspot_threshold,
267            "penalty_weight_uniformity": self.penalty_weight_uniformity,
268            "penalty_weight_variance_time": self.penalty_weight_variance_time,
269        }

282class BrachyDwellTime(BaseModel, ABC):
283    """
284    ### Purpose:
285    - An abstract class (solver independent) to represent a DwellTimeVariable in the dwell time optimization problem.
286    This class is used to define the properties of a dwell time variable, such as its name, initial dwell time,
287    lower and upper bounds, coordinates, dose rate map, and the variable in the optimization model.
288    It is used to create instances of DwellTimeVariable for each dwell position in the catheter table.
289    """
290

334class BrachyDwellTimeOptim(ABC):
335    r"""
336    ### Purpose:
337    - An abstract dwell time optimizer class to specify the common components of a dwell time optimizer class that
338    easily integrates to BrachyUtils.
339    ### Attributes:
340    - plan: The brachytherapy plan to be optimized. Note that the plan will be modified in place.
341    - solver: The name of the solver to be used for optimization.
342    - dwellTimeVariables: The set of the dwellTimeVariables to be optimized. In HDR brachy, dwell times and catheter positions.
343    - model: The object that incorporates all the attributes above to output the optimal dwell_time for each DwellTimeVariable.
344    - roi_bounds: The coordinate bounds for the optimization region of interest (roi) from the plan.
345    - roi_margin_mm: The distance from the furthest dwell position along each axis to consider voxels the dose rate maps.
346    - solution_found: A boolean indicating whether a solution was found.
347    - solve_time: The time taken to solve the optimization problem.
348    ### Functions:
349    - initialize_model: A function to initialize the optimization model (prepare the solver and the log files).
350    - set_dwellTimeVariables: A function to create the DwellTimeVariable objects based on the treatment plan. 
351    - set_penalty_function_and_constraints: A function to set the penalty function and constraints for the optimization.
352    - run: A function to run the optimization model inside the solver and capture the solve time.
353    - get_optimized_plan_from_model: A function to get the optimized BrachyPlan from the model.
354    - bound_dwell_time: A function to bound the dwell time of a DwellTimeVariable.
355    """
356    @abstractmethod
357    def __init__(self):
358        r"""
359        ### Purpose:
360        - A function to initialize the optimizer object with the plan and solver.
361        ### Parameters:
362        - roi_margin_mm: The distance from the furthest dwell position along each axis
363        to consider voxels the dose rate maps. for each axis:
364            roi_bounds = [first dwell - margin : last dwell + margin]
365        """
366        self.plan: Any
367        self.solver: str = None
368        self.dwellTimeVariables: List[BrachyDwellTime] = None
369        self.model: Any = None
370        self.roi_bounds: List[List[float]] = None  # [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max], [z_min, z_max]]
371        self.roi_margin_mm: List[float] | float = 3.0
372        self.solution_found: bool = False
373        self.solve_time: float = 0.0
374
375    @abstractmethod
376    def initialize_model(
377        self,
378        solver: str,
379        pth_logfile: str = None
380    ) -> Any:
381        r"""
382        ### Purpose:
383        - A function to initialize the model. The model is the object that incorporates all
384        the attributes above to output the optimal dwell_time for each DwellTimeVariable.
385        ### Inputs:
386        - solver:str := The name of the solver to be used. Default is None.
387        - pth_logfile:str := The path to the log file for the solver. Default is None.
388        ### Outputs:
389        - model: Any := The model object.
390        """
391        pass
392
393    @abstractmethod
394    def set_dwellTimeVariables(
395        self,
396        plan: BrachyPlan,
397        initial_dwell_time: float = 0.0,
398        lower_bound: float = 0.0,
399        upper_bound: float = 100,
400    ) -> List[BrachyDwellTime]:
401        r"""
402        ### Purpose:
403        - A function to get the dwellTimeVariables from the plan.
404        The dwellTimeVariables are dwell times for each dwell positon inside the catehter table.
405        ### Inputs:
406        - plan: BrachyPlan := The plan should have a catheter table with at least one dwell position.
407        - initial_dwell_time:float := The initial dwell_time of the DwellTimeVariable. Default is 0.
408        - lower_bound:float := The lower bound of the DwellTimeVariable. Default is 0.
409        - upper_bound:float := The upper bound of the DwellTimeVariable. Default is 100.
410        ### Outputs:
411        - DwellTimeVariable_list:List[DwellTimeVariable] := A list of dwellTimeVariables to be optimized. The dwellTimeVariables are the dwell times
412        for each dwell position inside the catheter table.
413        """
414        pass
415
416    @abstractmethod
417    def set_penalty_function_and_constraints(
418        self,
419        plan: BrachyPlan,
420        dwellTimeVariables: List[Any],
421        model: Any,
422    ) -> None:
423        r"""
424        - A function to set up the optimization model's objective function and constraints based 
425        on the plan.
426        """
427        pass
428
429    @abstractmethod
430    def run(self):
431        r"""
432        - A function to run the underlying mathematical solver and capture the solution 
433        status and solve time.
434        """
435        pass
436
437    @abstractmethod
438    def get_optimized_plan_from_model(
439        self,
440        inplace=True,
441    ) -> BrachyPlan | None:
442        r"""
443        ### Purpose:
444        - A function to get the optimized plan from the model after the optimization is done.
445        - This method calls `self.run()` to perform the optimization.
446        - If no optimal solution is found, the method returns `None`.
447        By default, the plan is updated in place. If inplace is False, a new plan is returned.
448        Note that plan is a very large object and it is not recommended to copy it.
449        ### Inputs:
450        - inplace:bool := If True, the plan is updated in place. If False, a new plan is returned.
451        ### Outputs:
452        - outplan:BrachyPlan | None := The optimized plan if an optimal solution is found, otherwise None. The plan is updated in place by default.
453        """
454        pass

472        ### Outputs:
473        - None
474        """

28class DwellTime_Gurobi(BrachyDwellTime):
29    r"""
30    ### Purpose:
31    - A class to represent a DwellTimeVariable in the dwell time optimization problem using Gurobi.
32    See `BrachyDwellTime` for more details on the attributes and methods.
33    """
34    def build_backend_variable(self, model):
35        if not isinstance(model, Model):
36            raise ValueError("Model is not a Gurobi model. Please provide a Gurobi model.")
37        self._model_variable = model.addVar(
38            lb=self.lower_bound,
39            ub=self.upper_bound,
40            name=self.name,
41            vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS
42        )
43
44    def set_bounds(self, *, lower_bound: float | None = None, upper_bound: float | None = None) -> None:
45        r"""
46        See `BrachyDwellTime.set_bounds` for details.
47        """
48        if lower_bound is not None:
49            self.lower_bound = lower_bound
50            self._model_variable.lb = lower_bound
51        if upper_bound is not None:
52            self.upper_bound = upper_bound
53            self._model_variable.ub = upper_bound
54    
55    def __init__(self, model: Model, **data):
56        r"""
57        ### Purpose:
58        - A function to initialize the DwellTimeVariable.
59        ### Inputs:
60        - model: Model := The Gurobi model object.
61        - data: dict := The data to initialize the DwellTimeVariable.
62        """
63        super().__init__(**data)
64        self.build_backend_variable(model)

def get_optimized_dwelltimes_from_model(model: gurobipy._model.Model) -> List[gurobipy._core.Var]: 
113def get_optimized_dwelltimes_from_model(
114    model: Model,
115    ) -> List[Var]:
116    r"""
117    ### Purpose:
118    - To run the model and get the optimized dwell times as a list
119    """
120    model, solution_found, solve_time = _run(model)
121
122    if not solution_found:
123        warnings.warn(
124            "No optimal solution found. Return None.",
125            stacklevel=2)
126        return None
127
128    dwell_name_time = {}
129    for x in model.getVars():
130        if (x.VarName.startswith("dwell_")):
131            dwell_name_time[x.VarName.split("dwell_")[-1]] = x.X
132    return dwell_name_time, solution_found, solve_time

class CatheterTableOptim_Gurobi: 
 96class CatheterTableOptim_Gurobi():
 97    r"""
 98    ### Purpose:
 99    - a class to optimize the catheter table using Gurobi.
100
101    ### Attributes:
102    - `plan`: BrachyPlan := the brachytherapy plan to be optimized.
103    - `solver`: str := the solver used for optimization. default is "gurobi"
104    - `model`: Model := the Gurobi optimization model.
105    - `catheter_vars`: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi] := the catheter
106    variables used in the optimization.
107    - `dwellTimeVariables`: List[DwellTime_Gurobi] := the dwell time
108    variables used in the optimization.
109    - `roi_bounds`: List[List[float]] := the bounds of the regions of interest
110    used in the optimization.
111    - `roi_margin_mm`: float := margin in mm to add around the ROIs when resampling to the optimization grid.
112    - `solution_found`: bool := whether a solution was found.
113    - `solve_time`: float := the time taken to solve the optimization problem.
114    - `build_time`: float := the time taken to build the optimization model from plan.
115
116    ### No handles, no blueprint - names are the single source of truth:
117    Penalty slack variables and constraints follow a fixed, predictable naming convention
118    (`p_L_{structure_name}[i]`, `c_L_{structure_name}[i]`, `p_U_{structure_name}[i]`,
119    `c_U_{structure_name}[i]`, `p_H_{hotspot_suffix}[i]`, `c_H_{hotspot_suffix}[i]`). Nothing about
120    them is cached on this class or anywhere else: `update_penalty_weights_and_voxel_goals` regenerates
121    these names on the fly from each `Optimization_Config` (`structure_name`, `num_dose_points`,
122    `hotspot_masks`, `hotspot_num_dose_points`) and resolves the live Gurobi objects via
123    `model.getVarByName`/`model.getQConstrByName`. This means there is nothing to keep in sync, and
124    nothing that becomes stale or invalid if the model is copied, saved/reloaded, or passed around.
125
126    ### Important note on constraint attributes:
127    Every dose constraint created here (`c_L_*`, `c_U_*`, `c_H_*`) involves the bilinear term
128    `c_MVar * t_MVar` (catheter indicator times dwell time). Gurobi therefore stores these as
129    QUADRATIC constraints (`QConstr`/`MQConstr`), even though they look like plain linear dose
130    constraints. That means their right-hand side is read/written through `QCRHS`, NOT `RHS`, and
131    they must be looked up with `getQConstrByName`, NOT `getConstrByName`.
132    """
133
134    def __init__(
135        self,
136        plan: BrachyPlan,
137        roi_margin_mm: float = None,
138        multi_processing: bool = False,
139        pth_logfile: Path = "temp_data/gurobi_model.log"
140    ):
141        r"""
142        ### Purpose:
143        - An catheter table optimization object for Gurobi solver.
144        ### Inputs:
145        - `plan`: BrachyPlan := the brachytherapy plan to be optimized.
146        - `roi_margin_mm`: float := margin in mm to add around the ROIs when resampling to the optimization grid.
147        - `multi_processing`: bool := whether to use multi-processing for cropping, masking and resampling
148        dose rate maps.
149        """
150        # Initialize the attributes to their default values
151        self.plan: BrachyPlan = plan
152        self.solver = "gurobi"
153        self.model = None
154        self.catheter_vars: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi] = []
155        self.dwellTimeVariables: List[DwellTime_Gurobi] = []
156        self.roi_margin_mm: List[float] = None
157        self.roi_bounds: List[List[float]] = None
158
159        if roi_margin_mm is not None:
160            self.roi_margin_mm: float = (
161                roi_margin_mm if isinstance(roi_margin_mm, list)
162                else [roi_margin_mm] * 3
163            )
164
165        self.solution_found: bool = False
166        self.solve_time: float = 0.0
167        self.build_time: float = 0.0
168        self.multi_processing = multi_processing
169
170        # start building this optimization object
171        t0_build = time()
172        self.model = self.initialize_model(self.solver, pth_logfile=pth_logfile)
173        self.catheter_vars = self.set_catheter_variables(
174            plan=self.plan,
175            model=self.model,
176        )
177
178        self.dwellTimeVariables = list(chain.from_iterable(self.catheter_vars))
179
180        if self.roi_margin_mm is not None:
181            self.roi_bounds = get_optimization_roi_bounds(
182                plan=self.plan,
183                dwellTimeVariables=self.dwellTimeVariables,
184                roi_margin_mm=self.roi_margin_mm,
185            )
186
187        set_dwell_coef_dict_per_structure(
188            plan=self.plan,
189            dwellTimeVariables=self.dwellTimeVariables,
190            optim_roi_bounds=self.roi_bounds,
191            multi_processing=multi_processing,
192        )
193
194        self._bound_dwell_times_to_catheters(
195            dwellTimeVariables=self.dwellTimeVariables,
196            catheter_vars=self.catheter_vars,
197            model=self.model,
198        )
199
200        self.set_penalty_function_and_constraints(
201            optimization_configs=[
202                struc.optimization_config
203                for struc in self.plan.structure_list
204                if struc.optimization_config is not None],
205            dwellTimeVariables=self.dwellTimeVariables,
206            catheter_vars=self.catheter_vars,
207            model=self.model,
208        )
209
210        if plan.optimization_constraint_dict is not None:
211            self.set_constraints(
212                constraint_config_dict=plan.optimization_constraint_dict)
213        t1_build = time()
214        self.build_time = t1_build - t0_build
215
216    def initialize_model(self, solver: str, pth_logfile: str = None) -> Model:
217        r"""
218        ### Purpose:
219        - initializes the Gurobi optimization model and set the log paths.
220        ### Inputs:
221        - `solver`: str := the solver to be used. only "gurobi" is supported.
222        - `pth_logfile`: Optional[Path] := the path to the logfile. if
223        None, default is temp_data/gurobi_model.log.
224        ### Returns:
225        - Model := the initialized Gurobi model.
226        """
227        if solver.lower() != "gurobi":
228            raise ValueError("Only Gurobi solver is supported in this class.")
229        if pth_logfile is None:
230            pth_logfile = Path("temp_data/gurobi_model.log").resolve()
231        pth_logfile = Path(pth_logfile)
232        pth_logfile.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
233        model = Model("CatheterTable_Optimization")
234        model.Params.TimeLimit = 180  # set a time limit.
235        # model.setParam("MIPFocus", 1)  # was not helpful.
236        model.setParam("PreSOS1BigM", -1)
237        model.setParam("LogFile", str(pth_logfile))
238        model.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)  # set to 0 to suppress output
239        return model
240
241    def set_catheter_variables(
242        self,
243        plan: BrachyPlan,
244        model: Model,
245        catheter_vars_to_keep: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi] = None,
246    ) -> List[CatheterVar_Gurobi]:
247        r"""
248        ### Purpose:
249        - To extract catheter variables from the plan (catheter table and dose rate dict).
250        If a catheter is already in catheter_vars_to_keep, it will not be re-written
251        ### Inputs:
252        - plan:= Brachy plan with a new catheter table and dose rate dict
253        - model:= the optimization model that will have the new catheter and dwell time variables
254        - catheter_vars_to_keep:= The list of catheter variables that we want to keep in the model
255        otherwise, they will be re-written.
256        ### Output:
257        - List[CatheterVar_Gurobi] := the new list of catheter variables that have been added
258        to the model.
259        """
260        return set_catheter_variables(
261            plan=plan,
262            model=model,
263            catheter_vars_to_keep=catheter_vars_to_keep,
264        )
265
266    def set_penalty_function_and_constraints(
267        self,
268        optimization_configs: List[Optimization_Config],
269        dwellTimeVariables: List[DwellTime_Gurobi],
270        catheter_vars: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi],
271        model: Model,
272        cleanup: bool = True,
273    ):
274        r"""
275        ### Purpose:
276        - sets the penalty function and constraints for the optimization model.
277        ### Inputs:
278        - `optimization_configs`: List[Optimization_Config] := List of optimization configs containing the
279        penalty weights, target dose, mask, dwell_coef_dict and other attibutes.
280        - `catheter_vars`: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi] := the catheter variables to be used in the optimization.
281        - `model`: Model := the Gurobi model to which the variables will be added.
282        - `cleanup`: bool := if True (default), any slack variables/constraints previously created by a
283        prior call of this function for the *same* structures are removed first. This makes it safe to
284        call this function repeatedly (e.g. after changing the structure list or masks) without
285        accumulating duplicate variables/constraints, since Gurobi does NOT deduplicate by name on its own.
286        ### Output:
287        - None: the model's variables/constraints/objective are created and set to match the current
288        `optimization_configs` values. Nothing is returned or cached on `self` - every subsequent
289        weight/target-dose update resolves objects by name via `update_penalty_weights_and_voxel_goals`.
290        """
291        set_penalty_function_and_constraints(
292            optimization_configs=optimization_configs,
293            dwellTimeVariables=dwellTimeVariables,
294            catheter_vars=catheter_vars,
295            model=model,
296            cleanup=cleanup,
297        )
298
299    def update_penalty_weights_and_voxel_goals(
300        self,
301        optimization_configs: List[Optimization_Config],
302    ):
303        r"""
304        ### Purpose:
305        - Dynamically updates penalty weights and/or the per-voxel target dose for structures that
306        already have slack variables/constraints in `self.model` (i.e.
307        `set_penalty_function_and_constraints` has already been called at least once). Does NOT call
308        `addVar`/`addConstr`: it regenerates the expected variable/constraint names from each
309        `Optimization_Config` and resolves them via `getVarByName`/`getQConstrByName`, then mutates
310        `Obj`, `QCRHS` and `UB` attributes in place.
311        ### Inputs:
312        - `optimization_configs`: List[Optimization_Config] := the (updated) optimization configs.
313        ### Output:
314        - None: `self.model`'s objective, quadratic-constraint RHS, and variable bounds are updated in place.
315        """
316        update_penalty_weights_and_voxel_goals(
317            model=self.model,
318            optimization_configs=optimization_configs,
319        )
320
321    def run(self):
322        r"""
323        ### Purpose:
324        - A function to run the optimizer. See `BrachyDwellTimeOptim.run` for details.
325        """
326        self.model, self.solution_found, self.solve_time = _run(self.model)
327
328    def get_optimized_plan_from_model(
329        self,
330        inplace: bool = True,
331    ) -> BrachyPlan | None:
332        r"""
333        See `BrachyDwellTime.get_optimized_plan_from_model` for details.
334        """
335        self.model, outplan, self.solution_found, self.solve_time = _get_optimized_plan_from_model(
336            plan=self.plan,
337            model=self.model,
338            inplace=inplace,
339        )
340        return outplan
341
342    def set_constraints(
343        self,
344        constraint_config_dict: Dict[str, Constraint_Config],
345    ):
346        """
347        ### Purpose:
348        - To update the model with the new constraints. The type of the constraints can be
349        "bound", "sum", "uniqueness", "continuity", "num_catheters", "collision", each is explained in
350        Constraint_Config class. The target variables for the constraints can be "catheter" or "dwell".
351        - Each constraint should have a unique name generated automatically by the Constraint_Config class.
352
353        ### Inputs:
354        - constraint_configs Dict[str, Constraint_Config]: See Constraint_Config for details.
355        The key of this dictionary is the name of the constraint, which should be unique.
356        - model (Model): The model containing the variables. The name of the variables in the constraint list
357        should match the name of the variable. Otherwies, Error will be thrown.
358
359        ### Outputs:
360        - None: model is updated with the new constraints
361        """
362        set_constraints(
363            constraint_config_dict=constraint_config_dict,
364            model=self.model,
365        )
366
367    def _bound_dwell_times_to_catheters(
368        self,
369        dwellTimeVariables: List[DwellTime_Gurobi],
370        catheter_vars: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi],
371        model: Model,
372        cohesion_type: Literal["BigM", "Indicator"] = "Indicator"):
373        r"""
374        We bound each dwell time variable to be equal to that variable multiplied by its corresponding
375        catheter variable. t = ct. This ensures that if a catheter variable is zeor, the dwell time is
376        also zero.
377        """
378        t_MVar = MVar([dt._model_variable for dt in dwellTimeVariables])
379        c_MVar = MVar([c._model_variable for c in catheter_vars for _ in c])
380
381        if cohesion_type == "BigM":
382            t_MVar_Max = np.array([
383                dt._model_variable.UB
384                for dt in dwellTimeVariables])
385            model.addConstr(
386                t_MVar <= c_MVar * t_MVar_Max,
387                name="cohesion")
388        elif cohesion_type == "Indicator":
389            for c_var, t_var in zip(c_MVar.tolist(), t_MVar.tolist()):
390                model.addGenConstrIndicator(
391                    c_var, False, t_var, GRB.EQUAL, 0.0,
392                    name="cohesion")
393        model.update()
394
395    def remove_constraints(
396        self,
397        constraint_config_dict: Dict[str, Constraint_Config],
398    ):
399        r"""
400        ### Purpose:
401        - To remove a set of constraints from the model by their name
402        """
403        remove_constraints(
404            constraint_config_dict=constraint_config_dict,
405            model=self.model,
406        )

Purpose:

  • a class to optimize the catheter table using Gurobi.

Attributes:

  • plan: BrachyPlan := the brachytherapy plan to be optimized.
  • solver: str := the solver used for optimization. default is "gurobi"
  • model: Model := the Gurobi optimization model.
  • catheter_vars: List[CatheterVar_Gurobi] := the catheter variables used in the optimization.
  • dwellTimeVariables: List[DwellTime_Gurobi] := the dwell time variables used in the optimization.
  • roi_bounds: List[List[float]] := the bounds of the regions of interest used in the optimization.
  • roi_margin_mm: float := margin in mm to add around the ROIs when resampling to the optimization grid.
  • solution_found: bool := whether a solution was found.
  • solve_time: float := the time taken to solve the optimization problem.
  • build_time: float := the time taken to build the optimization model from plan.

No handles, no blueprint - names are the single source of truth:

Penalty slack variables and constraints follow a fixed, predictable naming convention (p_L_{structure_name}[i], c_L_{structure_name}[i], p_U_{structure_name}[i], c_U_{structure_name}[i], p_H_{hotspot_suffix}[i], c_H_{hotspot_suffix}[i]). Nothing about them is cached on this class or anywhere else: update_penalty_weights_and_voxel_goals regenerates these names on the fly from each Optimization_Config (structure_name, num_dose_points, hotspot_masks, hotspot_num_dose_points) and resolves the live Gurobi objects via model.getVarByName/model.getQConstrByName. This means there is nothing to keep in sync, and nothing that becomes stale or invalid if the model is copied, saved/reloaded, or passed around.

Important note on constraint attributes:

Every dose constraint created here (c_L_*, c_U_*, c_H_*) involves the bilinear term c_MVar * t_MVar (catheter indicator times dwell time). Gurobi therefore stores these as QUADRATIC constraints (QConstr/MQConstr), even though they look like plain linear dose constraints. That means their right-hand side is read/written through QCRHS, NOT RHS, and they must be looked up with getQConstrByName, NOT getConstrByName.
